tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /chos grwa chen po gsang sngags bde chen gling gi bca' yig lhag bsam nyi 'od gsal ba'i 'od snang zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru badzra dhā ra ya/ dus gsum rgyal kun spro bsdu'i byed po gang / /dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang / /sngags 'chang mchog dang dge slong mdzes pa'i skur/ /yongs shar rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la 'dud/ /sa gsum snang byed mkhyen rab 'od zer gyis/ /skya seng lta bu gzhan sde kun 'joms pa'i/ /ma rig las 'khon 'od gsal lha yi rigs/ /nges don 'jam dbyangs brgyud par bcas la 'dud/ /khyad par snyigs dus rgyal bstan spel ba la/ /bsam bzhin byon pa'i sngags 'chang chos kyi rje/ /ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen dang / /rigs sras dbon brgyud rim can phyag gi gnas/ /rig gnas kun mkhyen mkhyen bzang paṇḍi ta/ /skyon med khrims gnas gnas brtan btsun pa'i mchog /'chad rtsod rtsom mkhas mkhas dbang sngags 'chang rje/ /thams cad mkhyen pa a mes zhabs la 'dud/ /mchog thun dngos grub kun stsol yi dam lha/ /bar chad kun sel chos srung nor lhar bcas/ /skyabs gnas dam pa kun la gsol 'debs na/ /'phral dang yun du shis pa'i dge legs stsol/ /zhes rnam kun dge ba'i tshig sngon du btang nas/ 'dir dpal sa skya'i rje btsun gong ma'i thugs dam gyi nying khu gsang chen rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i 'byung khungs chos grwa chen po shrī bde chen gling na bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun rnams nas bsgrigs lam kun spyod mdzad dgos tshul mdo tsam zhu na de yang sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal pos thub bstan lha khang chen po'i dge 'dun rnams la bstsal ba'i bca' yig bslab pa kun btus las/ gdan sa dan khrod nas 'byon pa rnams kyi cha lugs sngags dgon gyi bca' yig nang bzhin byed/ ces gsungs pa la dpags na/ gsang chen chos grwa 'di la'ang sngags 'chang nyid kyi bca' yig zhig yod 'dra yang /

de rjes byon pa'i bla ma gong ma rnams kyi bka' tho phran bu yod gras su'ang / de rigs kyi gsal cha ma shar zhing / dgon gyi las tshan rnams kyi rtsis khra'i gras su'ang med cing gdan sa chen po'i nye skor gyi phyag dpe'i khrod nas kyang sngar phan ma rnyed pas/ slar dpe khang chos mdzod chen mo yongs rdzogs la nged rang nas lta rtog bgyis pas rnyed tshe dge 'dun rnams la zhu rgyu dang / de min sngags 'chang nyid kyis gnang stsol gnang bzhed yod kyang gnang ma thub pa zhig byung ngam snyam pa bcas/ gang ltar da lam sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i rnam thar ngo mtshar rgya mtsho nas 'byung ba'i shugs bstan rnams dang / sgar chen gyis mdzad pa'i ban gtsang ba'i bca' yig 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i gling kha bde ba can gyi bca' yig dam pa de nyid kyi bka' shog rin po che rnams gtso bor bzung / bstan pa'i rnam gzhag mdo rgyud bstan bcos nas 'byung ba rang gi blo yul du nges pa rnams la gzhi blangs/ 'phral gyi bsgribs lam mig mthong lag zin tshang mar gegs sel bogs 'don gyi snying gtam 'gyod med kyi tshul du zhu na/ de yang sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i rnam thar ngo mtshar rgya mtsho las/ de lta bu'i chos grwa chen po thub bstan lha chen legs par thebs pa'i rjes tsam la/ gsang sngags bde chen gling zhes bya ba'i sngags dgon chen mo 'di yang 'debs par mdzad pa yin te/ sngon gyi dus su sa phyogs 'di nyid na chos 'khor rtse mo ba zhes grags pa'i sde pa lha khang pa'i 'og tu gtogs pa ban gzugs la kun spyod rtsing hral bag med kho na byed pa'i sa skya pa'i zhal ngo gdung rgyud rnams la yang zhabs 'dren rim par bsgrub pa dang / mchod gzhis rnams la yang chom po sogs byed pa'i ngan pa tshan gcig yod pa las/ dus phyis sngags 'chang bla ma nyid kyi mthu stobs kyi gzi 'od chen pos thams cad chab 'bangs su rang dbang med par 'dus pa na/

sngar gyi ngan spyod byed pa'i ngan pa kha cig ni/ sngar rang gis byas pa'i nyes pa rnams dran nas phyogs gzhan dag tu song bar gyur la/ la la ni 'gyod pa chen pos bdag nyid chen por mthol bshags dang bcas rjes su 'dzin par gsol ba 'debs par gyur la/ phal cher ni sngags 'chang nyid kyi bka' bzhin bslab pa skyor ba sogs dad gus dang bcas pa bgyis pas dge 'dun rags bsdus zhig gi steng thub bstan lha chen nas kyang dge 'dun bgres pa rnams byon pa'i zhal grangs brgya phrag tsam longs par mdzad nas der bzhugs rnams kyi spangs bzhes mdzad dgos la/ gzhi tshul khrims rnam par dag pa la gnas par byas nas/ spyir bshad pa rgyud sde mtha' dag la mkhas pa/ nyams len man ngag rgya mtsho la dbang 'byor ba/ lag len cho ga'i cha lag phra mo bris thig dbyangs gsum tshun chad la byang chub pa zhig dang / khyad par sa skya'i yab chos yang phur rnam gnyis/ bde kyai gsang gsum/ yo ga dang bcas pa'i cho ga cha lag rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis/ chos skyong gi bskang zlog gar 'chams/ gdangs dbyangs/ rol mo sogs kyi phyag len rnam par dag pa rnams chig rkya pher ba'i bca' khrims nan chen mdzad nas/ bdag nyid chen po rang nyid rdo rje slob dpon du rtag par 'byon dus dkyil 'khor re re nas kyang thog mar cho ga'i sgrig rtsom gyi skabs mchod 'phreng bstod pa sogs la kun gyi rna bar snyan zhing yid khul bar nus pa'i gdangs dbyangs kyi khyad par ngo mtshar can ji snyed dang / tha na rdor dril 'dzin tshul tshun la yang dwang 'dod bstan pa'i mig rgyan la phan nges pa dgos tshul gyi bslab bya ched gnyer du mdzad pa sogs kyi legs lam la bstan/ da lta'i bar du yang gsang sngags kyi cho ga phyag len gyi gras la sngags 'chang bla ma nyid kyi rjes 'jug rnams las ngo mtshar che ba gangs can gyi khrod na med pa kun gyi mthun snang du grub pa 'di yin la/ de nas sgrub mchod dngos gzhi phyag len phra mo tshun chad la'ang sla chos sogs gtan mi mdzad par/

sku gsung thugs bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i tshig don gyi cha la g.yeng ba gang gis kyang mi brdzi bar rtse gcig tu gzhol ba'i ting nge 'dzin bzang po dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas nyin mtshan khor yug tu cho ga chen po rnams kyang tshar gnyis la sogs pa mdzad cing / de dag gi bar mtshams rnams su yang dbang gi dngos lta sbrel ma re mdzad pa'i tshe/ sku 'khor rnams lus sems shin tu ngal bar gyur kyang / sngags 'chang bla ma nyid la sku dub pa'i tshul la sogs pa cung zad kyang med cing / sku mdangs kyang je rgyas su 'gro ba dang / gsung las kyang bla ma gong ma sangs rgyas dang 'dra ba rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i dus bzang 'di rnams la/ rang re rnams chos phyir du lus sems ngal ba tsam byung na tshe rabs mang po'i sdig pa rnams dus gcig la 'dag nges pa skal ba shin tu bzang ba yin kyang / da dus kyis ma khyogs pas deng sang gi chos par rlom pa 'di rnams/ rang gi skye ba mang po nas sdig pa gsos pa la nyin gcig kyang ma dal bar bsags pa rnams brjed/ tshe 'dir chos phyir du nyi ma gsum bzhi tsam ngal ba re byung na de tsam yang mi theg par skyo skad kho na 'don/ bza' btung dang dkor rdzas byung na ji tsam byung yang chog tshod med par da dung gzhan gyi dpal 'byor la phrag dog gi mtho dman bar gsum kun la don med du ngan smras kho na smra/ snying thag pa nas blang dor bstan na de la dga' ba mi byed khar bla ma dang grogs mched kun la 'khon du 'dzin/ mdor na bza' btung ster ba snga phyi tsam dang / 'dug sa mtho dma' tsam la'ang khro nus pa'i deng sang gi grwa slob 'di rnams ni/ sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung las/ 'das pa'i sangs rgyas bye bas ma thul ba/ /so so skye bos 'dul ba'i skabs yod dam/ /zhes dang / yang sa lo chen pos/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /nyin dang mtshan mo lan drug tu/ /g.yel med sems can la gzigs kyang /

/mos gus gdung ba'i 'brel med pas/ /las ngan de dag skyob mi nus/ /zhes dang / spyod 'jug las/ deng nas brtson par ma byas na/ /'og nas 'og tu 'gro bar 'gyur/ /sems can thams cad phan mdzad pa'i/ /sangs rgyas grangs med 'das gyur kyang / /bdag ni rang gi nyes pas de'i/ /gso ba'i spyod yul ma gyur to/ /zhes gsungs pa rnams kyis lung zin lta bur 'dug pas/ nga 'dra bas phan thogs par ma mchis/ 'on kyang sa lo nyid la gsol ba btab nas/ nged rang dang skal ba mnyam pa'i slob ma rnams ngan song du mi 'gro tsam zhig e yong snyam pa'i zhi drag bsres pa'i lab gleng sogs thabs mkhas sna tshogs zhig byas pa yin pas/ khyed rnams kyis go dgos zhes yang yang bka' bstsal nas/ sngar gyi ser khyim pa gnas pa'i yul la chos 'khor rtse mo zhes bya ba'i ming yod pa de spo bar mdzad nas/ de tshun chad gsang sngags bde chen gling du mtshan gsol ba yin zhes 'byung bas/ dngos gzhi bca' yig gi snying po thams cad 'di kho nar ma 'dus pa mi 'dug kyang / go gsed kyis yang yang ma zhus na so skye rnams kyis snying po'i don log par 'brel ba 'di mang bas/ de rjes sgar chen gyi bca' yig las 'byung tshul yang / grub thob kyi gsung gang thon thon zhig 'dug kyang / 'dir go rim bsgrigs nas zhu na/ dge 'dun gyi dbyen dang / phra ma dang / bslab par skyon yod na ye shes spyan ldan rnams kyis gzigs pa dang / rdo rje'i chos skyong srung mas dam bca' dran par mdzod/ rgyun gyi kha 'don bzlas brjod gtor ma sogs ma chags pa gal che/ tshogs 'du 'tshogs la snga phyi ma shor ba/ tshogs phyag kyang yan lag lnga sa la phab pa'i grwa phyag blos bslangs byed pa ma gtogs khral 'jal gnya' ba mgo 'phyang gis phyag mi byed/ pus gral rnga gral gang 'grig rnga dpon rol dpon sogs la bstun nas 'don pa skyor ba/ zhwa gyon pa/ rnga rol 'grig pa/

rol mo dang dung la snga phyi ma shor ba sogs gang 'grig bya dgos/ rol chen dus ja thug mi 'dzed/ ja thug 'dzed dus rnga sding lag pa g.yon la 'gel/ ja thug sogs la hub sgra/ cag sgra/ thu sgra sogs mi byed/ dka' yol ja phor rnams lces mi ldag zan sogs la lag rtsed/ gral 'phros/ gzan gyis mgo gtum/ kha gtum/ skra ring mo 'jog sogs gtan nas mi byed/ chab ma blangs par har langs rgyab hreng sogs mi mdzes pa'i rigs mi byed/ mdor na kun spyod tshang ma la spang blang dang 'dod ngos/ spang bya rnams las 'bras las bsams pas sla bcos su ma song bar so so nas nges par gyis/ 'gal ba shar tshe srung ma spyi dang pu tra dmar nag 'khor bcas kyis rtsa ba'i bla ma grags pa blo gros kyi bka' dam dran par gyis lo zla ma 'gyangs par sgrol ba dang / chos mthun bca' yig bzhin byed pa rnams kyi bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang / tshe ring nad med bde skyid phun tshogs sogs/ /bsam don chos bzhin 'grub pa'i phrin las gyis/ /zhes mdor bsdus 'di gsungs pa'i rgyab bsnon du chos skyong rnams la bka' bsgo'i yi ge zhig kyang rtsom par mdzad cing / de rjes gong gi gral rim nang ltar na 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyi gsung 'byung nges/ 'dir dgos pa'i dbang gis rjes su bzhag nas/ rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa de nyid kyi bka' shog gi snying po ni/ bka' shog de nyid las/ skabs thob lag len gyi snying por/ deng sang gi gnas skabs su 'dus tshogs sgrub mchod sogs mgyogs skyon lta bu yong 'dug pa/ de yang dge 'dun byings kyis 'ur 'don ma mdzad pa'i skyon yin 'dra zhing / zhal 'don chad pa dang chad la nye ba 'di rnams rtsa ba'i skyon brtsad na/ thog mar rgyugs 'bul gyi skabs thugs rje che ba mngon du song ba'i rjes su rang rang la drin chung gi skyon kho nar song ba de yin min thugs gzhigs gnang bas gsal zhing /

da skabs thob dbu byed rnams nas zhal 'don dal bus bskul ba dang / gzhan tshang mas mgyogs bul dbu mdzad dang bstun pa'i 'ur sgra ci che dang / blo gsal ba rnams kyis rgyugs kyi skor dge rgan so sor rang gi dge gzhon la 'jur dam mdzad pa'i rgyugs dpe tshang 'grig 'dzin 'jug cing / ma zin par rgyugs 'bul mi byed/ phugs rigs dge gzhon la drin chung ma yin pa'i drin chen zhig nges par mdzad dgos/ dbu mdzad sogs rgyugs bzhes pa rnams nas mgo mjug tshang ma gnon pa dang / gal te ma 'grig tshe dka' gnas rnams nas 'chol gnon bya ba dang / dbyangs rol tshig bri thig mtshams sogs rang nang du ngo tsha mi dgos par chig rkya pher bar bya dgos/ tshogs rjes ma zin pa dang dgos med du dgongs pa zhus pa byung na de nyin gyi tshogs skal mi ster/ khams stod smad nas grwa pa gcod pa rnams sngar nas bzung lo gsum re nas sdod srol mi 'dug pas/ lo gcig slob gnyer/ gnyis par chos dbang zhu ci thub/ gsum par bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin nas log 'gro ba'i do dam ban gtsang dbu mdzad gsum dang mchod dpon pas byed/ gzhi grwa'i mgor phyogs grwa mi 'jog pa ni 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyis mchod dpon smon lam rin chen la bka' bkod gnang ba bzhin mchod dpon pas gral bkod byed/ zhal 'don rnams dal bus btang zhing 'gro che mdzad na mchod gnas rnams rang gi gsol ba'i yon sbyong ba dang / sbyin bdag gi 'di phyi'i don 'grub pa sogs rgyu tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa las 'bras bu 'phral yun gyi phan bde thob pa yin pas gong bkod tshang ma dge 'dun rnams kyi thugs la bzhag do dam brgya tsho dpon/ ban gtsang dbu mdzad gsum/ bsnyen song dbu mdzad/ chos khrims pa rnams kyis byas ngos gong sar slebs rgyang yod pa zhig gal che/ zhes pa'i bka' slob du 'dug pas/ 'di ni dam pa de nyid kyi gsung sor bzhag bar skabs kyi tshig kha re nged rang nas bsnan te/

bca' yig gi khungs su 'dir bkod pa yin la/ de rjes 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i gling kha bde ba can gyi bca' yig la mgon de'i gsung gi zig ma khag che ba gzhan/ nged rang nas zhu 'os rnams kyang lhan cig tu sbyar ba zhig zhu rgyu ni/ spyir sems can gyi bde skyid sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la rag las/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen la rag las/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen dge 'dun gyi sde la rag las/ dge 'dun gyi sde bstan pa stobs kyis 'dzin pa'i rgyal srid la rag las par bshad cing / de lta bu'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu rtsod pa dang bral ba sngon byon pa gang gis legs par btab pa'i dgon gnas chos grwa 'di rnams la deng sang gi bstan pa stobs kyis 'dzin pa'i skyes chen rnams nas bkur bsti zhabs tog sogs gces spras su mdzad nas 'gro ba thams cad la srid zhi'i 'byor pa rgyun mi chad par 'byung zhing / gces spras su mdzad pa'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dge 'dun gyi sde dang bcas pas kyang mdo rgyud dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa la thos bsam sgom gsum gyi sgo nas bde bar gshegs pa'i ring lugs rnam dag tu 'dzin pa ni ci nas kyang gal che ste/ bdag nyid chen po sa paṇa gyis/ ci phyir zhe na rgyal ba yi/ /rin chen chos kyang dkon la ni/ /rtag tu 'tshe ba'ang mang zhes gsungs/ /'di la sems la mkhas rnams kyis/ /rtag tu bstan pa'i byi dor bya/ /zhes dang / nyin gcig gi ni skyel ma'am/ /tshe gcig gi ni nye 'brel la'ang / /'bad de brtags nas len pa mthong / /de nas brtsams te rdzogs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas ma thob bar gyi don/ /zhes pa nas/ kye ma snyigs ma'i dus 'dir mtshar/ /'bad mi dgos la 'bad par byed/ /'bad dgos chos dang bla ma ni/ /ci yang rung bas tshim par snang / /zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs pas so/ /des na da res skabs su babs pa rang re rnams kyi dgon gnas chos grwa chen po gsang sngags bde chen gling 'di nyid du rje btsun gong ma'i sngags phyogs kyi bzhed gzhung rnam dag 'dzin pa'i dge 'dun gyi sde zhig tshugs na ci ma rung snyam pa bla ma gong ma mang po'i thugs dgongs kyi lhag mar lus pa sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal pos mthar phyin du sgrub par mdzad pa yin te/

rje rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po dag zhing du gshegs kha'i gsung sgros las/ da 'gro na'ang sems kyi 'khri ba sa skya'i dan stod de la chos khrims gtsang ma zhig byung na snyam rtsol ba cher byas pa yin te de'i spros pa ni chod 'dug gzhan sems kyi lhag ma cung zad kyang med ces gsungs pa dang / bdag chen rdo rje 'chang skyed lhas na bzhugs skabs zhe dgon mkhan po paṇa chen nyi zla seng ge mjal bar byon dus gsung las/ nged rang gi bsam pa bzhin byung na sa skya'i skye phreng yan la lam 'bras sogs sa skya pa'i sngags phyogs kyi chos grwa bzang po zhig ci la thug kyang tshugs par byed snyam pa yod pas/ de dag gi mgo ma la khyed bzhugs dgos zhes gsungs pa sogs bla ma gong ma mang po zhig nas sngags grwa 'dzugs bzhed thun mong min pa gnang yang phyag thog tu ma khel ba de sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal pos 'bad med lhun grub tu 'dzugs par mdzad pa'i dgon gnas khyad par can 'di nyid du/ snga thog mkhan chen dpal ldan bzang po nas bzung mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyi bar tsam du mkhan rabs rim par byon nas rgyud dang man ngag gi bshad nyan shin tu dar zhing / dus phyis phyogs nas chos phyogs su dka' spyad sdug khur gyis 'byon pa nyung ba dang / gdan sa'i chos gzhis rnams 'khos kha zhan pas dge 'dun gyi zhal grangs shin tu nyung bar brten/ lho byang gnyis ka'i mkhan po thub bstan lha chen na bzhugs pa rim can 'dis 'khob par mdzad cing / 'chad nyan gyi rtsa ba rnams gdung rgyud kyis 'gan blangs/ bar skabs su lha khang mkhan rin po che kha shas nas lam 'bras sgrub thabs brgya rgyam sogs gnang ba byung 'dug cing / gzhan yang brgya tsho dpon chos las pa gnyis/ ban gtsang pa'i dbu byed/ mchod dpon pa sogs mkhas grub tu byon pa kha cig gis sngags phyogs kyi 'chad nyan kha yar mdzad pa dang / ngor/ gong dkar/ mdar grong mo che/

mus sogs nas byon pa'i bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen kha shas nas rgyud bshad man ngag bshad khrid/ dbang lung byin rlabs rjes gnang sogs rgya cher bka' drin bstsal ba la brten/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po nas 'jam mgon a mes zhabs yab sras kyi bar du byon pa'i bde gling 'dus tshogs rnams kyang bstan pa'i bya ba thos bsam sgom gsum dang / mkhas pa'i bya ba 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas rje btsun gong ma'i sngags phyogs kyi bstan 'dzin 'gran bral kho na byung 'dug kyang dus phyis bstan pa mar 'grib la thug pas dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi dgon gnas che phra phal cher gyi bca' khrims rnams lo re bzhin lhod par 'gyur ba zhig 'dug pa nas/ 'dir bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun rnams la yang 'khrul zad gong ma rnams kyis bcas pa'i bka' khrims kyi rgyun bzang po mtha' dag ma nyams pa'i phyir/ gsal 'debs cung zad brjod na/ 'dus tshogs rnams 'phral yun kun tu gzhi tshul khrims rnam par dag pa la gnas pa'i steng / thos bsam gyis rgyud phyug par byas nas zab mo'i don nyams su len pa la rtse gcig tu mdzad dgos te/ ji skad du/ tshul gnas thos dang bsam ldan pas/ /sgom pa la ni rab tu sbyor/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ de yang sngags grwa 'di nyid du ni thog mar bsgrigs rgyugs pa nas bzung rdor dril rnga sogs phung pos 'chun pa zhig dgos pas lo bco brgyad ma lon bar thub bstan lha chen du sbyong ba bya/ de nas byang gi bsgrigs gral tshud nas kyang / rgyud sde rnams la/ grub thob kyi spyod pa la bsgyur ma ran bar gsang sngags pa yin kyang 'dul ba'i kun spyod dang mthun pa zhig nges pa bya dgos par gsungs te/ rdo rje phreng ba las/ phyi ru nyan thos spyod pas bsrungs/ /nang du 'dus pa'i rgyud la mkhas/ /zhes dang / slob dpon 'jam dpal grags pas/ sdom gsum cho gar mi ldan pas/ /sngags kyi bdag nyid mi 'grub ste/

/zhes dang / ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gis gsang 'dus lam rim las/ de nyid bcu shes nyan thos chos ldan pa'i/ /rdo rje slob dpon tshul bzhin mnyes byed shog /ces gsungs pas na/ thog mar sdom gsum so so'i ngo bo ngos bzung nas/ srung sdom byed tshul cung zad brjod na/ sdug bsngal gyi 'byung gnas 'khor ba'i btson ra las gtan du thar pa'i rnam par grol ba dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu don du gnyer ba'i blos/ gzhan la gnod pa'i bsam sbyor ngan pa dug bzhin du spangs te/ 'dod chung chog shes bsten pa ni so thar sdom pa'i ngo bo yin la/ de'i bslab bya'i gtso bo rags sdom bcu zhes pa mi dge ba bcu spong ba 'di nyid du 'dus te/ bcu gang zhe na/ srog gcod rku dang 'dod log ste lus kyi las gsum/ rdzun dang phra ma tshig rtsub ngag 'khyal te ngag gi bzhi/ brnab sems gnod sems log lta ste yid kyi gsum rnams nan tan gyi sgo nas bsrung dgos shing de dag gi gtso bo srog gcod rku/ 'dod log rdzun te rtsa ba bzhi la yan lag rnams tshang ba'i skyon zhugs na sdom pa rtsa ba nas gtong bas/ rang nyid tho lum me 'bar za ba'i dmyal bar skye zhing / nyams grib dge 'dun rnams la phog nas skyes sbyangs kyi yon tan la gegs byed pas bstan pa'i mig rgyan dang rang gzhan la phan pa'i phyir gnas dbyung / mdo sgrub kyi mtshams gcod byed/ lhag ma drug la skyon zhugs pa dang / lo ra/ lo tog 'joms pa/ sho/ mig mangs/ rdo skor/ mda' rtsed/ mchongs/ dgon khrod du rgyang 'bod dang / bag med kyi tshong sogs byas pa byung na brgya phyag 'gel/ bag med nyes pa skye pa'i rtsa ba chang yin pas/ chos byed rnams kyis dug can gyi zas ltar spong dgos kyang / deng sang bstan pa nyams su 'dod pas dkor gyis myos shing nag phyogs kyis rgyud bslad pa'i ngan pa dag lhan cig tu 'dus nas chang la bag med du spyod cing /

rang re nang tshang yin pas 'di tsam gyis ci skyon gzhan la gzabs pas chog zer ba 'di mang bar gda' ste/ sdom ldan rnams kyis myos 'gyur bag med btung ba lta bu ci smos cung zad tsam gyis kyang khro chu 'thung ba'i dmyal bar skye bar bshad pas/ sdug bsngal myong ba'i rgyu 'di la dgos pa e 'dug shes ldan rnams kyis gzigs/ gsang sngags kyi skabs su dam tshig gi rdzas kyi gtso bo chang yin mod/ sbyangs rtogs sbar gsum gyi nus pa mngon sum du ma gyur bar rgyud sde rnams las sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga'ang sman gsungs pa dang cha 'dra bar rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos slob spring du bla ma gong ma'i gsung rab kyi bcud bsdus nas sdom ldan rnams kyi bstan pa'i gzhi ma la phan pa'i phyir tshogs 'khor gyi skabs su'ang bu ram sogs chu la sbyar ba'i khu ba chang du dmigs nas bsten dgos par gsungs pas na/ slan chad lcags ri'i khongs dang phyi'i gtsug lag khang sogs dge 'dun bzhugs gnas rnams su chang bag med 'grim pa byung na tshod re la mar khal re sogs snod che chung la dpags pa'i mar chad 'gel lugs dang / chang snod chogs la chag dum bde gling gi rgyal sgor sgrog pa'i do dam brgya dpon/ ban gtsang dbu byed/ mchod dpon/ bsnyen sogs dbu chos rnams nas ngo dga' drag zhan du ma song ba byed cing / mar chad de dge 'dun spyi'i ja rdor sogs su 'bul ba'am/ yang na sgrub mchod rnams kyi skabs mchod mer 'bul/ lcags ri'i khongs dang phyi'i bzhugs gnas rnams su bud med dang btsun ma sogs 'grim pa byung na phan tshun gnyis char la mar zho do re'i chad pa 'gel/ bu nad can nang du lus pa lta bur ma dang spun sogs 'phrad tsam dgos na las tshan rnams la gnang ba zhus nas nyin 'phrad zhag grangs gang 'os dang / mtshan sdod mi byed pa rnams ni pha lam sor sdom gyi char gtogs spang blangs byed dgos rags tsam dang /

byang sdom ni/ ma gyur 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal dngos brgyud sel ba'i slad du/ don gnyis mthar phyin sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob 'dod kyis blos rang nyid gces 'dzin gyi sems spangs te/ gzhan phan gyi bsam sbyor gtso bor bya ba ni byang sdom gyi ngo bo yin la/ de'i bslab bya ni/ bdag gzhan mnyam brje'i byang chub kyi sems kyi kun nas bslangs te rgyu'i theg pa dang thun mong ba dang / rang smin byed phar phyin drug la bslab pa/ gzhan smin byed bsdu dngos bzhi la bslab pa/ nag po'i chos bzhi spangs te dkar po'i chos bzhi bsgrub pa/ nam mkha'i snying po'i mdo las 'byung ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhi sogs byang sems kyi spang blang rnams gsung ngag lam 'bras kyi snang gsum skabs dang / brgyud pa'i khyad par gnyis ldan gyi sems bskyed sogs las ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin thos bsam gyi sgo nas spang blang nan tan du byed cing / de'i khar gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde rnams las gzhan phan byed tshul zhi rgyas dbang drag gi las tshogs rab 'byams gsungs pa rnams kyang tshad ldan gong ma'i gsung rab las 'byung ba ltar nyams su blang ngo / /de dag gis mi mthun phyogs mthu gtad zas min mi chen bskul bskyed/ kha 'thab lag 'thab/ rma khrag 'pho ba sogs gnod pa bsam bzhin du bskyal ba byung na las tshan rnams kyis 'di khar gsal sleb par gyis/ nyes pa che gras de dag la hor khrims gyi rtsa ra dang / gzhan rnams la'ang chad pa ljid yang gang rung re nged rang gis kha ltas khyab par byed/ sngags sdom gyi chos grwa 'di nyid kyi gtso bo yin pas/ de yang tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas rang sems 'khrul pas bslad pa la brten/ rtog pas brtags pa'i snod bcud sogs tha mal pa'i snang ba 'di rnams snang stong rang bzhin lha sku bde ba chen po'i rol par gdod ma nas gnas pa la de ltar du shes par bya ba'i phyir/ bskyed rdzogs kyi ting nge 'dzin zab mo bsgom pa ni sngags sdom gyi ngo bo yin la de ma thob pa thob par byed pa sogs gsang sngags kyis rtsa ba ni dbang bskur nyid la rag las pas gong gi bka' shog tu lo gnyis pa la dbang chos zhu gsung ba 'dug kyang gzhi grwa dang phyogs grwa thams cad dbang bskur thob pa ni shin tu gal che zhing de yang bla med kyi dkyil 'khor gang yang rung ba zhig tu thog ma nas 'jug pa'am/

yang na bya spyod sogs rim gyis zhugs kyang rung ba tsam yin pas/ stod smad kyi grwa rgyun rnams nas thog mar dbang bskur zhu/ de bzhin du 'dus sde tshang mas kyang dbang gsan rgyu'i rim pa spyi bka' rdo rje'i 'phreng ba/ gdugs dkar dri med rnam gnyis sogs bya rgyud kyi skor/ rnam snang mngon byang a ra pa tsa na lha lnga sogs spyod rgyud kyi skor/ rdor dbyings/ rtse mo/ dpal mchog sbyong dkyil bcu gnyis sogs rnal 'byor rgyud kyi skor/ gsang 'dus/ gshed dmar/ 'jigs byed sogs pha rgyud kyi skor/ rdo rje phur pa sogs ma rgyud sgo drug gi skor/ lū nag dril gsum gsang mtha'i skor/ kyai rdor 'di ma rgyud sgo drug gi nang nas gtogs kyang yab chos kyi gtso bo yin pas kyai rdo rjer bka' babs bzhi sogs zab pa gnyis med rgyud kyi skor/ rgya che ba gnyis med rgyud dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang bskur rnams gang thob thob 'bad pa chen po'i sgo nas zhu zhing / byin rlabs rjes gnang la'ang grub chen brgyad cu/ sgrub thabs brgya rgyam/ rgyud sde bzhi nas bshad pa'i zur bka'i rigs/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi gsan yig nas 'byung ba ltar dang / lam zab phyi nang sogs kyi byin rlabs kyi sgo mang po/ rgyud 'bum/ gtso che'i chos sna sogs rgya gzhung dang / gong ma lnga sogs rang lugs kyi bla ma gong ma rnams kyi gsung 'bum rnams dang / lam 'bras kyi be'u bum/ mkha' spyod ma/ chos skyong che chung / dmar po skor gsum gyi chos skor sogs lung gi rigs rgya che ba dang / rdo rje'i tshig rkang gi rnam 'grel sogs man ngag gi bshad pa/ bde kyai gsang gsum yo ga bya spyod sogs kyi rgyud bshad pa/ gsung ngag rin po che tshogs slob kyi skor/ bde mchog yab yum gsang 'dus/ gshed dmar/ 'jigs byed/ mgon po che chung rnams kyi dmigs rim khrid bka' zab mo'i rigs/

rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud sde rnams nas bshad cing / rgya bod mkhas grub tshad thub kyis bkral ba/ khyad par sa skya'i rje btsun gong ma'i bka' srol la zhugs pa rnams brgyud ldan bla ma dam pa rang re'i bstan 'dzin gyi gras su bzhugs pa sogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen khungs thub las nyan gang thub dang / dbang dang lam gyi gnas skabs su thob pa'i dam tshig srung sdom gyi spang blang bslab bya rnams bla mas ji skad bstan pa bzhin ci nus su srung sdom 'bad pas byed pa dang / thos bsam bya rgyu'i rim pa dang / kyai rdor rgyud gsum/ bde mchog gsang 'dus sogs kyi rgyud sde rnams dang / de dag gi dgongs 'grel rgya bod kyi gzhung tshad ldan spyi dang / bye brag rje btsun gong ma lnga/ ngor chen yab sras/ rdzong pa yab sras/ rdo rje gdan pa yab sras/ sa lo/ sngags 'chang yab sras/ tshar chen yab sras/ 'jam mgon a mes zhabs rnams kyi bka' 'bum nas 'byung ba'i chos 'byung rgyud bshad sgrub thabs kyi bshad pa sogs sngags phyogs la mkho che ba rnams 'dzin pa dang lta rtogs sogs rang gi dbang pos ci lcogs dang / khyad par rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis/ sdom gsum tshul gsum gsal rgyan/ rgyu 'bras theg pa'i spyi don mdo sngags bstan pa rgya mtsho'i sgo 'byed rnams 'dzin thub pa zhig byung na nges par gsang sngags kyi zab gnad rnams go ba zhig yong 'dra bas/ khyed rje btsun gong ma'i bstan pa la snying nas dad pa yod pa rnams dngos kyi bslab bya 'di snying khongs su bzhag ngos/ bstan pa la phan pa'i bya ba lhur len byed pa dang / snga sor rje btsun gong ma lnga nas sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje yan tsam la gdung rgyud bzhugs pa dang / brgya dpon/ brgya 'dra sogs kyi bla brang khag mang rnams su rgyud sde bzhi'i dkyil 'khor zhal 'byed grangs mang yod 'dug cing / de rjes sngags 'chang chen po'i sku thog la'ang hor zla drug par sa lo'i dus chen la phur sgrub zla gcig lhag tsam/

dgu par sa chen yab sras kyi dus mchod la gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa dang 'jam rdor gnyis re mos kyi zhag bdun re/ de'i nyer gcig dkon mchog lhun grub kyi dus chen la brtag gnyis rgyud 'don nyin gang ma/ bcu gcig pa'i slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo dang sa skya paṇḍi ta'i dus mchod la kyai rdor saṃ bu ṭa'i sgrub mchod zhag bdun re/ zla ba de'i 'phags pa'i dus chen la kyai rdor sgrub mchod la zhag gsum re/ gnyis pa'i rje btsun gyi dus mchod la bde mchog lū nag gnyis kyi sgrub mchod lo re mos kyi zhag bdun re/ bzhi pa'i rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i dus mchod la gur rigs bsdus sgrub mchod zhag gsum/ drug pa'i bla ma dam pa'i dus chen la yang dag sgrub mchod zhag bdun/ bdun pa'i sngags 'chang nyid kyi yum gyi dus chen la kun rig sgrub mchod zhag gsum/ de'i theg chen gyi dus mchod la gshed dmar sgrub mchod zhag lnga/ brgyad pa'i sngags 'chang nyid kyi yab kyi dus chen yang dag sgrub mchod zhag bcu rnams mdzad kyang / sngags 'chang nyid kyi sku tshe'i bar skabs su/ byang rgyal rin gsum 'khrugs/ bya sprul sbub pa zhugs kyi rtse 'brong blo bde rgyal rtse ba rnams kyi dmag gi 'go pa 'ja' mo ba dang thug khu bas byas/ gcen lung rdzong pa dam chos gcen lung khul gyi dmag rnams bskul te/ dmag mi shin tu stobs che bas lha khang chen mo bskor/ dpal chen pho brang bsam gling mgon khang bshig mchod gzhis thams cad phrogs pa la brten nas/ bde kyai gsang phur ma gtogs sgrub mchod chen mo rnams phal cher chags pa yin te/ de dus kyi 'bul sdud bar gnang ba'i spyi 'gro las/ lha sa rdzong par mthar dbyung thub tshul gnang ba'i rjes su/ mdo sngags kyi chos grwa sgrub sde sogs gsar 'debs 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po/ rje btsun gong ma lnga/ bla ma dam pa/ theg chen chos rje/

ngor chen rdo rje 'chang / sa lo chen po rnams kyi dus dran gyi mchod par bde kyai yang phur sogs kyi sgrub mchod gsar 'dzugs re ba bzhin byung ba yin na'ang / gtsang phyogs kyi sde dpon gsum gyi thugs gdon gyis dkrugs pa la brten/ dpal ldan sa skya'i 'khris su dmag sgar btab pa'i ngos nas nged rang sel 'don byed ces ma rungs pa'i las sna tshogs la brten/ sngon gyi 'khon rog dam pa rnams kyi bsti gnas dpal chen pho brang sa brdal la btang / chos gzhis gsar rnying thams cad 'phrog dam nyams lha sa rdzong pa dang phu gsum pa tshags su bcug nged rang la gdan sa dan gyi gtsug lag khang rnams dang / lha khang chen mo'i gtsug lag khang 'di nyid rkyang pa ma gtogs chos gzhis cung zad tsam yang med pa la brten/ gong du brjod pa'i bla ma gong ma'i tshul dus mchod/ sgrub sde dang mdo sngags kyi chos sde'i gsol phog gtsug lag khang gi dkar me dge rgyun sogs thams cad dus gcig la chags par brten/ zhes gsungs pas/ da lta ngo yod bde kyai gsang gsum/ phur pa/ 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyis 'dzugs par mdzad pa'i bdag med ma dang gzhan mkha' spyod ma/ kun rig rnams 'dug par/ de dag gi bsgrub dkyil tshang ma slob dpon ban gtsang dbu byed rnams nas kyang shin tu dag par bslabs/ slob ma rnams nas kyang de bzhin du sgrub dkyil ngag 'don dbu zhabs tshang ma bzung nas cha lag gdangs dbyangs phyag rgya 'don pa'i khrid rnams shin tu nges par bslabs/ tshogs rnams 'tshogs dus bstan pa'i mig rgyan la phan pa'i phyir chos gos rnam gsum 'chang ba'am/ min na'ang 'dul ba yul chos dang bstun gsung ba ltar ring 'gag sham thabs/ rngul gzan rtse zhwa dmar po/ bod lh+wam/ tshe rtse dmar ser gang rung bcas rab byung gi chas gtsang ma kho na ma gtogs/ ya ma zung byas pa la/ sngags chog la mkho ba'i rdor dril/ ḍā ma ru/ nang mchod/ 'thor nas/ dung chos/

dbu rgyan/ dar dpyangs sogs de dang de la dgos pa rnams tshang ma med na gong 'khod las tshan rnams kyis nyes pa che chung dang bstun mar chad 'os rigs bkag nas mchod mer 'bul/ tshogs nam 'tshog dus dung rnga sogs brda byung 'phral rtsol ba bskyed de phyi bshol med par cig char 'dus dgos rgyu la/ dkar chab tsam ma zin brgya phyag 'gel/ bdag mdun bum sogs ma zin na mar chad gang rung 'gel/ 'dus nas tshogs gral la bzhugs skabs na bza' bzhes tshul legs shing ha cang gi dgye rgu ya yo 'khyag 'khyog bag chol gyi 'dug stangs su ma song ba zhig dang / sngags chog rnams la ni phal tshig gis bsre lhad ma shor bar dgos tshul rgyud sde rjes 'brangs dang bcas pa rnams nas gsungs pas/ bstan don dgos gal can gyi 'phros gtam cung zad ma gtogs dgos med kyi lab tshig gcig kyang mi byed/ dngos gzhi'i gtso bo ting nge 'dzin gyi rim pa rnams khrid bka'/ zab mo thob pa'i rgyun skyong rgyu yod na dang de min sgrub dkyil so so'i bsam bya thams cad bshad rnams la zhib 'jug byas ngos/ skyes bu blo gros can rnams kyis gsal gang theb dang / go ba ye ma chags pa rnams kyi tshig rjes su sems la 'brang ba tsam zhig ni shin tu gal che bas de bzhin dang / 'don cha'i rigs dal brel gdangs dbyangs rdor dril sogs 'dzin tshul phyag rgya rnga rol dal brel dkar dung rkang gling 'bud mtshams/ dung chen 'bud mtshams/ zhwa gyon pa sogs tshang ma rang gi slob dpon des ji ltar bslab pa dang rdo rje slob dpon dbu mdzad rnga dpon rol dpon sogs mdzad pa de rnams la bstun pa'i dang 'dod bstan pa'i mig rgyan la phan pa kho na ma gtogs 'ol tshod rang rang gi rna bar gang dran du ma song ba zhig dang / gsol zas bzhes tshul tshub sogs kyi skor gong sgar chen gyi bca' yig tu gsal ba de sor bzhag mdzad pa sogs 'du tshogs kyi gnas skabs thams cad du spyi khyab la btang nas dmigs bsal bla mchod/

sman bla/ rgyud 'don/ sgrub mchod skor bskang ba gtor bzlog tshang ma'i zhal 'don gyi rim pa rnams phyag deb zur gsal bzhin lhag chad med pa mdzad nges/ zhal 'don rnams dal zhing sngags rnams sgra dag pa ting nge 'dzin gsal ba/ gdangs dbyangs lhun chags shing lhu rdzogs pa/ phyag rgya rnam dbye chod zin zang zing du ma song ba sogs cho ga'i yan lag phra mo tshun chad ji ltar mdzad tshul ni/ thog mar dbyangs slob pa la bdun te/ bslab bya'i dbyangs/ slob ma'i gnas/ slob dpon/ slob ma/ ji ltar bslab pa'i tshul/ ma bslab pa'i skyon/ bslab pa'i phan yon rnams su yod pa las/ bslab bya'i dbyangs la dbye ba rgyas par na bsam gyis mi khyab mod/ bsdu na ring thung gnyis su 'dus pa las/ dbyangs ring ji ltar ring yang mgo thung la mjug ring ba/ mjug thung la mgo ring ba ma yin par mgo lus 'tshams pa dang / dbyangs thung ji ltar thung yang rang gi lhu tshang zhing yan lag rdzogs pa dang / de gnyis thun mong du brjid dang ldan yang sgeg chags pa/ snyan yang rus ma shor ba/ gyong yang skabs skabs su khugs pa/ de dag kyang tshig ngo gsal ba/ mang po mgrin pa bsgrigs kyang skad cig nga ro du mas brgyan pa lta bu/ mdor na blun po yid khugs shing / mkhas pa rnams dgyes pa/ mchod 'os mnyes pa/ ya rabs dwang ba 'dren pa/ ma rabs blo khugs pa/ mkhas pa yid 'phrog pa/ mkhas rmongs kun gyis bsngags pa/ dgra bgegs byer ba/ dngos grub 'du ba zhig la dbyangs zhes bya bas/ de bslab pa'i gnas kyang gtsang zhing dben la brag chu 'thab sa/ skad la bogs 'byin pa'i gnas su/ slob dpon kyang dbyangs la mkhas shing ngang ring rgyud 'jam slob nus pa/ rnam g.yeng dag gi dbang du mi 'gro ba sogs kyi yon tan dang ldan pa zhig gis/ slob ma blo gros shes rab dang ldan pa/ dbyangs don du gnyer ba gre ngag bde ba/ dbyangs dang slob dpon la dad cing sems chung snying rus can zhig la/

slob dpon gyis bdag gi slob ma 'dis dbyangs shes na ci ma rung snyam pa'i sems bskyed sngon du btang bas/ thog mar skad chung ngus slob/ de nas cung zad che bar btang ste ngag rjes la khrid/ de nas mtho dma'i khyad par sogs dbyangs kyi gzugs la slob/ de nas 'gyur khugs la slob/ de nas slob ma skad che ba la slob dpon chung ba byas te skyon mtshang ngos bzung ste slob/ blo shin tu rmongs pa rnams la dum bur bcad la bslab bo/ /ma bslabs pa'i skyon ni/ bab chol kyi dbyangs/ rang bzo zhugs pa'i dbyangs/ rjes zlos kyi dbyangs sogs skyon nyi shu rtsa gcig dang / blo skyon/ tshig skyon/ lus skyon/ grogs skyon/ gdangs skyon rnams yin par gsungs/ bslabs pa'i phan yon ni/ 'phags pa mchod cing sems can la phan pa'i phyir gzhan la dbyangs sbyin pa ni sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa sogs gnas skabs su phar phyin drug mthar phyin pa dang / rang gzhan dwang ba 'dren cing / mthar thug yan lag drug cu'i gsung dbyangs thob pa sogs 'di skor gyi zhib cha tshang ma bdag nyid chen po sa paṇa gyi rol mo'i bstan bcos kyis rnam bshad 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyis mdzad pa blo gsal yid 'phrog bzhin shes par byas la chos spyod kyi dbyangs rnams dang / rdo rje phur pa/ gur drag chos skyong skor gyi dbyangs tshang ma 'jam dbyangs sku mched kyi dbyangs yig nas 'byung ba bzhin dbu byed rnams kyi drung nas lan gcig min par yang yang mthar phyin sbyong brdar byas nas/ tshogs su gcig kho nas bton pa lta bu dgos rgyu dang / de'i cha lag rnga rol ji ltar bya ba'i tshul ni/ lus shin tu drangs zhing skyil krung 'grig stangs nas mdzad skabs gral snyoms ngos/ rnga rnams phan tshun gcig gis gcig zur non tsam phreng ba dar la brgyus pa ltar 'grig cing mtho dman 'bur kyong dgye rgu sna tshogs su ma song bar byas la/

dbyug gu'am rnga yog sogs ming gi rnam grangs du ma dang ldan pa'i skul byed de lag mgo g.yas snying kha la mtho gang tsam ma reg par mtho bar brkyangs/ yu ba'i thad kyi ri thad nas rnga che chung dang bstun mtho gang mkhyid gang sogs kyi sar zhi ba la dal lhod/ rgyas pa gsal 'khrol/ dbang la snyan mdzes/ drag po la drag myur du rdung ba sogs rdung tshul thams cad rnga dpon gyi rjes su 'brangs nas rnga shin tu mang yang gcig gis brdung ba lta bu/ de bzhin du rol sel dkrol ba'i tshe yang / lus kyi 'dug stangs dang nyams sogs las bzhi dang sbyar la/ dam po ma yin pa'i lhod yangs byas/ brang la mi sbyar/ dbyug pa ltar mi 'phyar/ ka ba ltar mi hring bar lung thag srab mnyen steng ma srin mdzub dang / 'og ma mdzub chung la bskor nas lag mthil du 'phrul chags par byas la rol mo yin na mtheb sor rnams dgyes pa lhod yangs dang bcas pa dang / sil snyan yin na mtheb sor bsgrigs nas bzung / de gnyis ka'ang dpung pa lag ngar lag mthil rnams nas skad che chung gi 'phrul ston ngos/ rol dpon gang yin pa de dang bstun la rol mo'i rnam gzhag tshang ma chal chol du ma song bar grangs rnams rnam dbye chod cing snyan brjid rngam zil dang ldan pa/ rol sil grangs mang gcig gis dkrol ba lta bu bya dgos pas de dag gi rnam dbye zhib pa gong du bkod pa'i bstan bcos ngo mtshar can de nyid dang sngags 'chang yab sras gsum/ 'jam mgon a mes zhabs rnams kyis mdzad pa'i rdo rje phur pa/ gur drag chos skyong skor gyi rol yig nang bzhin dbu mdzad mkhas pa rnams kyi drung du lan gcig min par yang yang gtugs ngos/ bla ma gong ma'i dgongs pa dang mthun zhing rang gzhan dwang ba 'dren pa zhig bya dgos shing / rdo rje dril bu'i rnam gzhag kyang rgyud sde'i don la sbyangs pa mthar phyin na bde blag tu rtogs kyang / spyir btang mkhas rmongs kun gyis go bde ba ni/

'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i rdor dril sogs kyi rnam gzhag ston pa'i bstan bcos le tshan gnyis las 'byung ba bzhin nges par byas nas de'i nang tshan deng sang shin tu mkho che ba las kyi rdo rje dril bu dang dam tshig gi rdo rje dril bu gnyis las/ las kyi rdo rje dril bu ni/ gtso bor yo ga nas bshad pa'i rtse dgu pa mgrin par bug pa can yi ge lam la zhal phyogs shing ci mi 'dra'i kha nas 'phyangs pa'i drwa ba'i dbus su rigs bzhi dang yum bzhi'i phyag mtshan g.yas pa/ de'i steng du rdo rje chur nyal zhing / ba lang kha'i steng rdo rje 'greng bus bskor ba'i dril bu 'di/ rdo rje rtse dgu rwa zum pa 'di yin par bshad pas dbang thob min gyi skye bo sna tshogs kyi sar bstan 'gro'i don la rdor dril 'chang dgos pa byung na 'di la bya zhing / dam tshig gi dril bu tshad ldan ni/ rtse lnga pa yi ge taṃ la zhal phyogs shing mgrin par bug pa med cing / gzhan rtse lnga'i khyad par ma gtogs gong dang 'dra ba 'di la dus phyis chen cha chung sogs tshad rnams mi 'grig pa shas che bas/ khungs thub ni theg chen gan dril 'di dang 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyi gsung rab nas 'byung ba shin tu 'grig pas/ 'di sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig gi rten du 'chang ba'i tshe/ thog mar sbyang ba gsum dang khrus bya/ rdo rje lha nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang / dril bu lha nyi shu rtsa gsum du bskyed pa sogs gzhung bzhin byas la/ mtshams bsnyen sgrub kyi skabs dang dbang thob dam tshig can yod na ma gtogs kun gyis ma mthong bar bcang bas mi 'bral ba'i dam tshig gsum ka 'di'i khongs su 'du bar bshad pas na shin tu 'khyer bde bas de bzhin bya dgos pas/ de dag 'dzin dkrol la'ang mang du gsung mod/ deng sang sngags chog la mkho che ba ni chig rdung ngam bcad gtub ming gcig pa de ni tshigs bcad gdangs med pa'i mtshams su dkrol ba 'di yin/

gsum rdung ni lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang zhes sogs la dkrol ba 'di yin/ rgyun chags ni rdor glu sogs la dkrol ba 'di yin/ dril stabs gsum 'khor ni gdangs dbyangs sogs la byed pa 'di yin/ lding khugs su dkrol ba ni rgyun chags kyi mu nas mjug bcad gtub lta bur bkrol ba dharmā ra ṇi tshar gsum sogs la byed pa 'di yin/ drag dkrol ni chig rdung dal dkrol 'di yin zhing / rdo rje gsor bskor dang g.yab mo dang gsor ba dang phyag 'tshal ba'i tshul ni rtogs sla bas de dag gi rnam gzhag kyang nges par byas/ gang la gang dgos de dang de'i gnas skabs su nor 'khrul med par bya ba las rnam gzhag med par byis pa'i rtsed mo ltar dkrol na mchod yul rnams kyi drang don gyi dgongs pa dang / gdon bgegs gzir bskrad sogs la sgra sna tshogs su go nas don log par 'gro bas gang yang mi 'grub pa sogs nyes pa 'byung bas na shin tu khungs btsun par bya dgos/ ḍā ma ru'i rnam gzhag ni rje btsun rin po ches he ru ka'i chas drug gi rnam bshad las gsungs pa'i cang te'u thod pa mtshan ldan ltag sprod dam/ be ta ltag sprod la bya dgos shing / de ma 'byor na gsom sogs gdug pa can gyi shing ma yin pa zhig la thod gzugs bcos pa'i nang gzungs rang gang mos kyi yi dam chos skyong gi sngags sam/ cho ga sna tshogs la dkrol chog par byed na dharmā ra ṇi'i sngags yig mgo phyir bstan g.yas bskor du bris/ mi sogs kyi pags pas g.yogs pa la sked nyag g.yas g.yon skul byed gnyis dang / 'chang bzung la dar dpyangs kyis mdzes pa/ 'chang rgyu'i tshad dang bzo dbyibs sogs las tshan rnams kyi phyag dam 'byar ma bzhin byas nas/ mchod rol sogs la rgyun chags/ ye shes dbab pa/ gdon bskrad pa/ spyan 'dren pa/ gtor ma 'bul ba rnams la drag dkrol bya/ nang mchod ni thod pa dngos sam be ta/ gser dngul zangs sogs rin po che las grub pa'am/

rdo rigs rdza sogs la thod gzugs bcos pas rung gi shing dang sprel thod bse sogs la mi bya zhing / 'chang rgyu'i tshad dang bzo dbyibs sogs las tshan rnams kyi phyag dam 'byar ma bzhin bya/ lcags lor nged rang nas tshogs mang la 'gyed rgyu'i nang mchod ḍā ma ru/ 'thor snod rnams zhe 'dre gsar bzos byang las thog pa'i rtsis khrir sbyar yod pas dam 'byar ma de ma dgos/ 'thor nas snod ni 'bru'i snod gang rung la bya zhing / de dag shom tshul ni mdun du stegs dang gzhi bzang yod pa'am/ gal te med na da lta dril gdan du grags pa 'di'i khar rang gi mdun g.yon nas rim pa bzhin nang mchod/ dril bu rdo rje/ ḍā ma ru/ 'thor nas rnams bsgrigs/ de dag las rdor dril ni lha dngos bskyed pa yin pas sku gsung thugs rten dang khyad med/ gzhan gsum mchod chas yin pas 'gom yug dang bza' btung gi 'phro 'thor ba sogs mi gtsang ba'i kun spyod thams cad spangs nas dad gus kyis bcang ba gal che/ dkar dung 'di la 'bud tshul nar ma dang / sgang dung chig rkyang ngam nas 'dra ma dang / drag dung dang / gdangs thung rnams su yod pa las/ nar ma ni 'tshog brdar 'bud pa'i bsgrigs dung ngam chig rdung yang yin kyang thog mar sbrel skad du grags pa sbom zhing 'dzer nyams yod pa dal bu'i mu nas dung byings ji ltar byed pa de dang 'tshams pa dang / de nas dung skad sbom phra snyoms zhing dal ba'i sked skabs tsam la gtser nyams su ma song ba'i skad gdangs mtho ba byed pa sogs da lta bzhin/ sgang dung ngam nas 'dra ba ni bcom rol gyi mgor byed pa 'di yin pas/ dung gdangs yun ring thung 'og tu rol mo dal brel ji ltar byed pa de dang bstun 'bud tshul deng sang bzhin/ gdangs thung ni 'dod yon lnga'i nang tshan sgra'i mchod pa'i skabs su byed pa 'di yin/ drag dung mtshams can ni deng sang bsgral mchod sogs la byed pa 'di yin zhing mtshams med ni 'dul ba'i gandhe drag rdung dang 'dra bar skad ngar grangs med du 'bud pa yin par bshad pas/

dkar dung gi skor la'ang rnam dbye chags par bya/ rkang gling la gdangs gsang sngags kyi man ngag bla ma gong ma'i gsung rab nas 'byung ba sna tshogs yod kyang gdan sa 'dir ni/ gur drag gi spyan 'dren la/ kyai yi dam myur du byon la dngos grub stsol cig bya ba yin zhes 'jam mgon dbang pos gsungs/ gzhan ni gtor bsngo'i skabs sogs la gur mgon gyi yi ge bdun ma dang / drag bskul sogs la 'bud pa 'di bcu gnyis ma yin zer ba tsam las gzhan med pas deng sang bzhin la spyan 'dren mchod pa la skad 'bol ba dang / bskul rnams la skad ngar bar bya/ zangs dung gi glu la rig gnas la byang chub pa rnams kyis rnam dbye sna tshogs byar yod kyang gdan sa 'dir grwa tshang nas 'bud skabs glu gar gtogs pa mjug bkra shis kyi dung gdangs 'di thos brgyud bzhin nges par bya zhing / thun mong du rol mo ma blangs par dung mi 'bud cing / dung skad 'bol zhing dal la ngang ring ba dang / skad phra ba bya dgos pa dang / bsgral mchod bzlog dung sogs kyi skabs ngar ba dang / byin 'bebs kyi rol mo kha bslangs chung ba rnams la mi 'bud/ dbyangs chen gyi bcom rol rnams kyi mthar dung skad shin tu ring ba'i rjes su 'dor gyi yun kyang bcom rol ring thung la dpag nas byed pa sogs gong bkod dbyangs nas bzung 'di bar tshang mar sbyong brdar snyoms las dang zhar byung du ma song ngos/ rang rang gi ngo skal du gang babs de la thogs pa med cing 'gang gtsang yong ba zhig so so nas theg pa khur blang bya ba dang / gzhan yang rdo rje slob dpon la nye bar mkho ba stangs stabs 'dug stangs yin par bshad pas de dag gi rnam gzhag zhib pa ni gur dang rdo rje phreng ba/ yo ga dus 'khor sogs nas bshad pa'i gar rnams yin yang / deng sang chos grwa 'di na rgyun mi bzhugs par shes par 'dod na rang lugs gong dkar rdo rje gdan dang / bu ston rin po che'i rjes 'brang bzhin khong du chud par bya/

de'i nang tshan 'chams kyi rnam gzhag shin tu mang yang gtso bor khungs btsun pa ni rdo rje phur pa'i 'chams skor 'dir 'dus pas/ de'i tshul snye thang pa'i 'chams yig dang / sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i snang ba 'gyur thub/ 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i 'chams yig le tshan gsum rnams las ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin/ bskul chung rgan pa rim can drung du shin tu mkhas shing byang bar bslabs/ nam zhig nyams su len pa'i tshe 'chams dpe snang ba 'gyur thub las/ rnal 'byor pa ting nge 'dzin las su rung zhing / bsnyen sgrub tshad du 'khyol ba'i gang zag yi dam lha'i nga rgyal brtan po dang ldan pa rnams/ phod ka rdor gong rus pa'i mgul rgyan/ se ral kha/ dgos pa rnams la skra tshab dang / zhwa theb la zhwa dar/ me long / zung mo chu thur/ rma bya'i sgro mdongs rnams kyis brgyan/ bla ma'i pur sol lam/ ro sol mar dang bsres pas sna zhur 'then pa sogs mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len bzhin/ bkod pa mdzes pa bshad tshod dang mthun pa chos dang mi 'gal ba'i chos gos lus la gyon zhing phur pa dar tshon sna lnga'am dkar dmar mthing gsum gyi cod paṇa can dang / bandha skra zhol can lag tu thogs/ gzhan snang shas mu 'phyor gyi chas snang ba la gang dran byas pa dang / snang shas nyon mongs kyi khog khengs kyang sgyid snyoms le lo dang / 'phang sems dbang gis snang shes med mdog gi rgyan la chas bor byas na bla ma chos bsrung gi bka' chad 'phral du yong nges pas/ snang shes lha mchod pa'i bsam pa ma nor ba rang gal che bas gzab 'tshal zhes dang / sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa'i 'chams bshad gsal ba'i me long las/ 'di thams cad la thun mong du dgos pa'i yan lag ni/ ro stod la seng chags pa/ sked pa la 'khril chags pa/ sgyid ma la ldem chags pa/ tshigs bzhi la 'khrul chags pa/ rkang mgo la bde chags pa/ zhag sha la lhod chags pa/ rnam 'gyur la 'gyings chags pa/

sha 'gyur la mer chags pa/ spyod pa dal zhing dod pa/ phyag rgya g.yas su bca' zhing grol na g.yon du de las ldog dbus su thad kar dal zhing 'gyings/ khyung nam mkha' la lding ba'i tshul gyis phod ka'i thang sha spyod pa dang / gangs stod kyi seng ge g.yu ral sprug pa'i tshul gyis ma ral gyi 'khril bshig pa dang / rgya stag nags la mchongs pa'i tshul gyis lus kyi 'dzum mdangs ston pa dang / gzhan yang rnam rtog ma g.yengs par lha'i ting nge 'dzin dran pa dang / gral gyis phreng ba bar thag snyoms shing / ha cang dal ba dang brel ba'i skyon spangs te phyag rgya'i rnam 'gyur bde zhing 'grigs pa gal che ba lags so/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / snang ba 'gyur thub las/ rol pa dang rol 'gros rnams kyi lag stabs thams cad 'dra ste/ mtho dman med par brgyangs la rgod nam mkhar lding ba lta bu'i lag gnyis kyi rtse mo gshog pa'i rtse mo ltar zlum po'i rnam pa legs shing mdzes pa kho na ma gtogs lag pa zha ba lta bu byung na mi yong bas/ lag gnyis mtho ba zhe gcig bya'o/ /zhes dang / yang de nyid las/ 'di'i skabs su sgyid pa rengs pa dang / rked pa chag cing / mgo gug pa/ ro stod sgur ba sogs 'chams kyi skyon che ba lags pas ma byung ba gal che'o/ /zhes dang / yang de nyid las/ 'di'i dgu brdegs la grangs mi 'dzin par rtsed 'phyo rgyug pa dang / blo la bde rtog gang med par phyin te/ dgu zhes pa 'grigs pa kho na byed pa ni gar 'chams ma yin/ dig pa'i rtog spyod 'ba' zhig yin pas spang bar bya'o/ /blo skyon med pas rgyug dgos pa ni thog ma nas 'chugs pa'i skyon yin pas gral bsgrigs pa'i dus zhal sprod kyi hrag la 'dom do las lhag pa ma byung ba byas na 'chams tshul shin tu 'grig cing legs par yong / zhes dang / yang de nyid las/ rnga rnga yog gi khyer dod pa/ lus rked ldem legs shing 'chams tshul mdzes la lus drang pa rang gtso bor byed pa ni rnga 'chams kyi khyad chos dam pa'o/

/de bstun rnga bya nyal dang phyi bsgyur nang bsgyur sogs mkhas la 'grigs pa dgos so/ /zhes dang / yang de nyid las/ 'chams dpon gyis jer drangs/ rnga brdungs pa'i nang nas skad snyan cing 'jebs pa gnyis gsum gcig 'chams dpon gyi drung nas du langs te mgur 'degs mkhas par byed/ rnga rdung pa gzhan rnams gral la bsdad pa de ga'i ngang nas dbyangs 'then pa ma gtogs thams cad langs nas bsod snyoms pa 'dra bas mi mdzes pas/ de ltar dgongs pa'i go nas 'chams pa rnga rdung pa dang bcas pa'i slob dpon rnams bsgrigs nas dbyangs snyan zhing gre 'gyur dod la 'grig cing yid 'khul ba dang bcas pas/ zhes dang / 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i tshogs skad las/ pad kor dang 'chams sna rnams du mdzad/ thams cad kyis 'chams dpon la ma g.yengs pa gzigs nas zang zing du ma song ba zhig dang / zhes sogs bla ma gong ma rnams kyis rgyas par gsungs pas na/ gzhung nas gnang ba dang / rang gis sgrub pa'i chas gos tshang ma sla chos khral 'jal tsam du ma song bar bstan pa'i mig rgyan la phan pa'i phyir chas rnams spus gtsang kha gsar bzo legs zhe gcig byas nges/ gyon tshul legs shing rtsa 'chams/ stangs stabs/ rnga 'chams/ bar 'dir dgos pa'i gser skyems sogs kyi 'chams/ nyung 'chams/ dur khrod bdag po/ grub 'chams skor tshang mar dwang dod lhur blangs kyi 'chams tshul 'grig cing rngam zil che ba/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa thams cad mnyes pa'i 'chams tshul kho na ma gtogs/ gral la thag ring thung / dal sar brel/ brel sar dal/ rnga chol rol chol/ 'ga' zhig gis g.yas btegs na gzhan gyis g.yon 'degs pa/ rgyab blta'i skabs mdun blta/ thun phyogs su 'gro phyogs la 'gro ba/ pad kor sogs rkang stabs lag stabs tshang ma thebs ma chag tsam byas pa sogs mdor na 'cham gyi gnas skabs su mi 'grig zing bshig tu 'gro ba su thad nas byas byung yang las tshan do dam pa tshang ma gcig tu bsgril/

phan tshun so so la 'di ltar 'dug gi brda dang gros bsdur nas nyes pa che chung la dpags brgya phyag mar chad sogs bkal sdud pa sogs gong 'os kyi chos khrims do dam bya/ de bzhin du dus mdos zab mo'i skabs dang / 'chams phran bu gtogs pa 'chams sku/ las mgon lnga/ phur bzlog drug cu pa sogs kyi zor 'chams/ phur bzlog khyi 'bag pa/ bzlog pa'i dzam 'gros rnams la'ang las sla dang / tshod mod du ma song bar bla ma gong ma'i dgongs pa dang mthun zhing / mthong ba brgyud pa'i lag len mtha' dag la dwang dod dang gzhan la spro ba bskyed pa kho na byed/ ban gtsang pas gtso byas grwa tshang tshang mas bris thig gtor bzo rnams kyang rgyud sde dang mthun pa zhig bya dgos rgyu la/ gdan sa 'dir phyag len phal cher ngor lugs gtso che bas/ thig rtsa kun mkhyen chen po dang / gung rus mdzad pa gnyis rtsa bar bzung / bde kyai gsang gsum phur pa/ bdag med ma rnams kyi dkyil 'khor dang / phur pa dang gur gyi bzlog dkyil gyi thig rtsa rnams gtso bor sbyang / zhar la rgyud sde bzhi'i dkyil 'khor mang po'i thig dang / las bzhi'i sbyin sreg mchod rten dang / blos bslang gi thig rtsa rnams kyang khong du chud par bya rgyur/ phyi lor zla ba dang po nas bzung slob dpon mkhas pa'i drung du gtugs la cha chen cha phran sogs rnam dbye chod cing thig chen brgyad/ rtsig thig 'dod snam/ pha gu/ drwa ba drwa phyed/ sgo rta babs/ khor yug rdo rwa me ris sogs kyi thig la nges shes shin tu 'grongs nges/ de phyin chad nas bzung thig grwa tshang rang nas thogs med du yong ba dang / de bzhin du gsang sngags zab mo'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor rnams la tshon ngan na sbyin bdag gi dpal nyams/ lha'i mtshan ma 'bri nyes na bar chad ldang zhing dngos grub yal/ rtsig pa la sogs pa yon por gyur na yul khams der nad yams 'byung / de dag rgyun chad pa dang sbom phra sna tshogs byung na rdo rje slob dpon dang sbyin bdag gi tshe thung ba sogs nyes pa mang du bskyed par gsungs pas/

thog mar rdul tshon kha dog lnga dang / kha dog lnga la mdangs bskyed pa'i tshon bsgyur ci dgos thams cad rang rang gi bkrag dang ldan zhing zhib par sbyor tshul gyi lag len shin tu mkhas par bslabs/ pa tra/ me tog rdo rje/ me ris/ zhi drag lha'i phyag mtshan sna tshogs/ sa bon la dgos pa'i lañtsa wartu'i yi ge bkra shis rdzas rtags sogs kyi ri mo rnams shin tu khungs chod cing lhongs che ba/ 'jam sha dang chags tshad lha bris thogs med du yong ba lta bur sbyangs la/ nam zhig bla ma gong ma'i dgongs rdzogs so so'i dkyil 'khor dang / dbang rgyun len bskur gyi phyir rgyud sde'i dkyil 'khor gang zhal 'byed kyang de dang de nas bshad pa'i tshad dang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs shing / las sla dang bab chol gang dran lta bur ma song bar/ mkhas grub su'i spyan lam du bstar kyang skyon 'dogs med cing thugs yid rang ba kho nas dus gnas thams cad du dwang dod kyi rtsal thon pa zhig grwa tshang thams cad kyis sbyong brdar byed rgyur/ snga sor dam pa de nyid kyi sku dus la'ang 'di dag la sbyang pa dgos tshul gyi bka' khyab dang rgyugs bzhes kyang mdzad dgos mchis kyang / slar mthar chags ma gnang ba lta bus de skabs su brdab shog che ba tsam las phugs kyi phan thogs pa zhig ma byung 'dug pa nas/ da phyin chad bris thig gnyis char grwa tshang rang nas 'pher ba dgos rgyur/ rtsa ba dang rdul tshon gyi sbyor sdebs kyang mchod dpon pa dang / ban gtsang pa rgan pa nas bzung gral rim dang / bsnyen song yang gral rim bgyis ngos/ ban gtsang pa re dang bsnyen song gsum re mi bzhis lo re bzhin rdul tshon zhib sbyor byed rgyu re mos dang / 'bri skabs kyang deng sang ban gtsang pa re mos tsam las mi 'dug kyang da nas bzung sgrub mchod phal cher gyi dkyil 'khor la ban gtsang pa gnyis dang bsnyen song gnyis/ phur sgrub chen po'i skabs ban gtsang pa gtor bzo ba gang dgos kyi 'phros yongs rdzogs dang /

bsnyen song gang dgos nas 'bri zhing / chog mang skabs dkyil 'khor che chung la dpags rang rang gi chog grwa ba 'os 'tshams kyis gong bkod bzhin mtshan nyid dang ldan par 'bri/ de dang rjes 'brel gsang sngags zab mo'i las rab 'byams sgrub pa la mkho ba 'khor lo'i bri cha tshang ma'ang mtshan nyid dang ldan pa bzhengs thub cing / yi ge dbu can dbu med rnams kyang khungs dang mthun pa sbyang ngos/ 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i dag yig la lta rtogs bgyis pas go myong phyug par byas nas/ bla ma gong ma'i tshul sgrub mchod dkar me dus ja'i 'bul sdud la 'gro skabs dgon gnas sbyin bdag che phra so so'i sar lugs gnyis kyi bya ba gang shar yang yi ge brda dag gzugs legs gzhan la re mi dgos pa rang gis btang chog pa dang / 'gro don sgrub phyir 'khor lo'i sngags/ gshin po'i ming byang / sku gzugs kyi gzungs/ gsung rab sogs ci bzhengs kyang sa phyogs de na gnas pa'i skye 'gro tshang mas rang kho na la re dgos pa lta bu zhig byung na rang gis mi shes pa'i skyon shes ldan la kha btang ba sogs kyi nyes pa bsrung ba dang 'phrin las 'gro don gyi sgo 'byed lta bur 'byung bas de bzhin dang / gtor ma dang rgyan bzo yang shin tu gtsang zhing bla ma gong ma'i dgongs pa dang mthun pa zhig dgos rgyu las phud phye dkar rgyan dmar rgyan sogs gtor ma'i dgos cha tshang mar gtsang sbra gang che dang / shom gyi tshe'ang rnam pa kun tu kha dang sna'i dbugs dang mchil ma snabs sogs bsrung phyir kha ras mthug po zhig sker 'bral med du 'chang ba'am nye skor zhig tu tshags byas la/ gtor ma mchod bsham gang byed kyi tshe des kha sna khyab par btum/ deng sang phal cher de rigs gtan nas mi byed cing / gal te gzhan gyis lhag bsam gyis ras sogs byin kyang mtho dman sna tshogs su dkris nas dngos gzhi'i 'bag btsog la khyad med lta bu byed pa 'di mang bas/

slan chad gong bkod bzhin byed pa dang / de bstun lag pa'ang shin tu dag par bkrus la gtor rdzas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga sogs 'dzoms pa ni bdud rtsi ril bu 'di yin pas/ 'di'i phye ma'am khu ba gang rung gi gta' bsres/ seng sgra/ rme brtsegs/ rnam 'joms sogs rgyud sde 'og ma rnams la bum rdzas nyer lnga bsres la zlum gtor padma'i snying po can padma 'dab bzhi 'dab brgyad gang rung gis bskor ba dang / chos skyong la mkho ba'i zur gsum rnams kyang drag po ma yin pa'i gnas skabs phal cher du dbyibs zur gsum la/ rtse zur zlum po rno med bya tshul sogs zhib pa bla ma gong ma'i sgrub yig so so nas 'byung ba dang / de dag gi nying khu nged rang nas brtsams pa'i gtor ma'i rnam gzhag gi yig chung bzhin shes par byed rgyur/ gtor spod chen mo'i skabs dang / mgon po mnga' gsol/ phur sgrub kyi gtor bzo rtse rgyan bcas bzo rgyu ban gtsang pa dang bsnyen song nyin ltar gral rim re mos kyis gang dgos dang / sa yos lo nas bzung ban gtsang pas rgyan bzo dang gtor bzo ma 'khob par khrol cha zhus stabs rgyan gtor gnyis bsnyen song la babs pa 'di byung / da ltar mi nag sogs gtsang btsog yod med sna tshogs kyi yan lag bkrus min la ma ltos par rtse rgyan dang gtor ma rnams la rjen 'jus kyis khyer 'gro ba zhig 'dug pas/ 'di ni mchod yul rnams la brnyas bcos tshabs chen dang / bstan pa'i mig rgyan la gnod cing / sbyin bdag dad pa log pa/ rang gi dam tshig nyams pa sogs nyes pa thams cad kyi 'byung khungs su mchis pas/ slan chad dge 'dun so so nas gtsang sbra dang dwang dod bcas mchod gtor tshang ma 'gan blang nges/ dmigs bsal bla ma gong ma'i spyi mchod pa dang / gtso thabs pa la dus mdos kyi mchod dpon gnang ba 'di dang / zor gtor/ gtor chen sogs rigs ngan gyis 'khur dgos pa rnams ma gtogs gzhan tshang ma grwa tshang rang nas byed pa ni shin tu gal che/

yang sngags grwa 'di'i bsgrigs lam kun spyod kyi gtso bo gcig ni bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin pa 'di yin pas/ de yang snga thog nas bzung rgyud bskang gso/ bde kyai gsang phur bdag med ma'i rgyugs sprod rnams song nas lam 'bras thob phyin kyai rdor gzhi bsnyen zla drug pa re song nas bsnyen chen pa dang / kī la ya'i mtshams zla gsum pa re song nas phur bsnyen par btags nas bsnyen chen pa rnams tshogs 'du tshang ma rgyug cing / lo gcig nas rnam 'joms/ rme brtsegs/ seng sgra/ chab klu sogs gzhan phan mchod gnas sna tshogs byas chog pa dang / phur bsnyen par tshogs 'du dmigs bsal kha rer phyin chog pa bcas 'dug par bsnyen pa 'di dag kyang khral 'jal lta bus bsnyen song ming thog gis chod tsam byas na rang nyes lci zhing rang gzhan la phan thogs dka' bas/ lo nar son bsam pa rnyed nas rang gis rang gcur thub pa'i tshod tsam la bsnyen yig nas 'byung ba bzhin/ gtso bor bsnyen pa byed po de rang gi brtson grus dang rtsol ba skyed/ 'phral gyi bskul ma skyon sel mtha' dag dge rgan nas yang dag par byas te/ bsnyen pa'i grangs chad lhag med pa sbyin sreg dang bcas pa mthar phyin byed rgyu la/ bde kyai gnyis kyi bsnyen thabs 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyi mdzad pa dang / bde mchog sbyin sreg sngags 'chang grags pa'i mtshan can gyis mdzad pa/ phur pa la bsnyen sgrub gsal byed mdor bsdus 'di las ma mchis pas yang phur gnyis dang gsang 'dus kyi bsnyen thabs yang dag sbyin sreg bcas slar nged rang nas rtsom thub pa byung na de bzhin dang / gsang 'dus sbyin sreg ngor chen rdo rje 'chang / phur pa'i sbyin sreg a mes zhabs/ bdag med ma ni kyai rdor gyi khongs su 'thus shing / zur du byed na i ring 'bum phrag bzhi dang / aṃ thung 'khor sngags bcas so so nas khri phrag bzhi re dang / mngon rtogs bsgyur ba tsam ma gtogs kyai rdor sor bzhag gis 'thus shing /

zla ba gsum gyi khongs su grub bam snyam/ mkha' spyod ma'i bsnyen thabs nged rang nas rtsom thub pa byung na de bzhin dang / gzhan bla ma gong ma rnams kyis mdzad pa nyung ngu kha shas 'dug pa ltar dang / sbyin sreg 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ kun rig bsnyen thabs sbyin sreg bcas des mdzad pa/ gur mgon gyi bsnyen thabs nged rang nas rtsom thub na de bzhin dang / sbyin sreg a mes zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ zhal gyi bsnyen thabs sbyin sreg sogs cha tshang zhig de snga mi 'dug kyang slar nged rang nas rtsom thub pa byung na de bzhin dang / gzhan dang / gzhan yang gshed dmar 'jigs byed sogs rang gang 'dod kyi yi dam chos srung nor lhar bcas pa'i bsnyen bsgrub tshad ldan ci nus su byed pa dang / med kha med du kyai rdor phur mgon gsum gyi bsnyen pa phal cher nas byed dgos pa ni sngags grwa 'di nyid kyi snying po yin zhing / rgyun gyi thugs dam gyi rim pa yang phur gnyis dang / chags med bzhi ni lam dus rgyas 'bring gnyis gcig tu bsdoms/ lam zab phyi nang gnyis bsdoms/ bir srung thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis bsdoms/ dril bu lus dkyil lam mkha' spyod ma gang rung la chag med bzhi zhes rje btsun gong ma rnams kyis thugs dam gyi gtso bor mdzad cing / gzhan yang lcogs tshe de'i khar gshed dmar lha lnga/ gur mgon brag rdzong la gsang khrid thob tshe de'i nyams len dang bcas pa/ zhal gur bdun ma'i tshe sgrub dang / gsang khrid thob tshe de nang bzhin gyi nyams len/ ku ru kulle'i phyi sgrub thun mong ma yin pa rnams dang / rje btsun sa skya pa'i lugs kyi gtor ma bcu bdun ma'am/ byang chub sems dpa' lugs kyi brgya rtsa'am shin tu bsdus dkar cha bzhi zhes pa mi g.yo sgrol ma klu gsum la zlum gtor yi dwags kyi chu sbyin rnams la zhes zhing / phyis kyi bla ma gong ma rnams kyis gzhi bdag bsnan par mdzad nas zan rigs kyang 'phar ba'i gtor ma bsdus pa 'di dang /

rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sbyin sreg bde kyai gnyis/ gur lha brgyad/ zhal dur bdag dkar bdud phur srung spyi gtor gzhi bdag gtor ma bcas gtor bsngo chen mo'i gzhung nas 'byung ba bzhin thub na legs shing / ma thub na lam zab nang ma phur kyai mkha' spyod ma rnams cis kyang thub pa zhig gal che/ bla ma gong ma'i tshul sgrub mchod/ dkar me dus ja'i thebs stod smad kyi 'bul sdud la 'gro skabs yig rtsis sman gsum shin tu mkho che bas yi ge sbyong tshul gong na gsal zhing / rtsis la le'u tho yongs rdzogs 'don nus pa sogs skar nag gi rtsis thams cad la byang chub pa'am/ de min yang lnga bsdus tsam zhig la byang chub pa dang / sman kyang rtsa chu ngo 'phrod cing sman gyi rigs mkho che ba phal cher ngos 'dzin thub pa tsam zhig gam/ yang na sman gyi rgyud 'grel pa dang bcas pa'i don pha lam lag thog tu 'khel ba sbyong brdar dang / mtshams sbyor sogs sgra rig la 'jug pa'am/ yang na dpang lo'i tshogs gsum gsal byed la 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyis mchan gnang ba 'dir lta rtogs dngos sngags rnams sgra dag tu yong ba zhig gal che bas de bzhin dang zhar byung sgrig lam kun spyod mthong ba brgyud pa ni rgyugs sprod kyi rim par/ thog mar rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis/ brgyud 'debs rgyud gtor bcas 'bul skabs rgyud phogs phyis nas len pa zhig 'dug kyang dpe 'dzin skabs chas ka'i gzhi rten yin pas slan chad dpe 'dzin gyi gong du zhu/ de nas bskang ba gzhung rkyang tsam las rgyugs sprod mi 'dug kyang / da nas bzung hor zla dang po dang drug pa/ mdos chen rnams kyi skabs rgyugs sprod pa rnams nas phur chung gtor bsngo/ bskang ba thugs dam ma'i sde tshan/ bstod pa rngam 'bar/ rab 'bar bcas sprod/ de nas bde kyai gsang gsum/ phur pa/ phur bzlog drug cu pa rnams gzhis phyogs kyi grwa pa tshang mas sprod/ bdag med ma dang rnal 'byor ma gzhis grwas sprod/

zhal gyi gtor bzlog bsnyen chen pa gzhis grwas 'bul dgos rnams 'dug pas/ drug cu'i skabs/ da nas bzung bskang gsar/ lha zhal/ pu tra dkar bdud rnams kyi sgos bskang dang / bstod rnying / srin sngon gang gsum ma hūm̐ gnyis rnams kyi rgyugs 'bul kyang byed/ phur bzlog gi skabs nged rang nas brtsams pa'i dkar bdud phur srung rnams kyi bstod pa rgyas pa'i rgyugs dang / phur sgrub chen po'i tshes gnyis rgyugs sprod skabs lhag ma dang gur drag gi rgyugs ma phrod na/ zla ba de'i nyer bzhi la gnyis char sprod/ tshar chen dgongs rdzogs skabs rnal 'byor ma 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang phyug gi yig cha nang bzhin zla ba de'i bcu bzhi la sprod dgos pas rgyugs sprod skabs mgo mjug tshang ma gnon pa las las sla dang tshod yod du ma song ba gal che/ gzhan bca' yig 'di thon phyin gong bkod sdom gsum tshul gsum gsal rgyan mdo sngags bstan pa rgya mtsho'i sgo 'byed rnams dbang rnon dag snang can rnams kyis skabs gang babs su rgyugs 'bul/ phur sgrub chen mo sogs sgrub mchod rnams kyi skabs dang / dus mdos kyi dmag ston bzhugs gral dang / sku rim chen mo'i phur bzlog gi nyer brgyad nas gnam gang gi bar dang / mdos chung drug cu pa'i nyer dgu'i dgong dang / rgyal po lo gsar dang / rab ston rnams kyi skabs su mkhan rgyal po lo gsar rab ston sogs ston mo'i rigs rin po che/ brgya dmag ston bzhugs gral sogs/ tsho dpon/ sgrub mchod gang 'os chos las pa gnyis dmigs bsal gzhis lan gcig zhur phur sgrub phur bzlog drug cu pa dus ma'i skabs res mos/ ban tshang pa/ sgrub mchod rnams la gral rim res mos bsnyen song bcas nas bshad pa 'bul dgos la/ 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i gdung rabs chen mo/ dpag bsam 'khri shing gi don 'grel/

gsung ngag chos bde gsang / 'jigs byed dus 'khor/ mgon po rnams kyi chos 'byung / rab gnas dang / phur pa'i stod las smad las sogs kyi rnam bshad dang / drug cu pa'i dris lan bcas mdor na mgon po de'i zhal sgo las byon pa'i bstan bcos ngo mtshar can rnams kyi steng nas bshad pa dag gsal snyan gsum gyi sgo nas 'bul/ ban tshang pa rnams kyi dmigs bsal mdzad rgyu la/ zla ba byung ngo cog la 'jam mgon a mes zhabs dang / sngags 'chang chen po dang bsod nams dbang po re mos/ mus chen dang grags blo ba re mos/ sngags 'chang kun dga' bkra shis/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang phyug dang / sa lo sgar chen sku 'bring rnams lhan rgyas kyi bla chos re dang / tshes mchod la/ 'jam mgon a mes zhabs/ sngags 'chang chen po/ grags pa blo gros/ kun dga' bkra shis/ bsod nams dbang phyug rnams dang / lo re ngag dbang chos grags/ bstan pa rab rgyas/ sgar chen sku 'bring / spyan snga rin po che rnams kyi dgongs rdzogs bla mchod/ zla re'i tshes bzhi'i rnam sras bskang ba/ gur drag brgyad/ bcu bzhi/ nyer gsum/ nyer drug nas gnam gang bar gyi dus gtor sman bla/ gtor spod kyi rigs/ rgya 'gros pa'i bskang gso/ smon lam/ lo bcol bcu tshigs gtang rags/ ril sgrub dang / dus mdos kyi bskang gso brgya tshar/ lha mo gsol mchod/ mdo sde'i skabs kyi bsangs/ dge tshes bzhi/ zhal gyi dam tshig bskang gsol mgon mdos sogs dmigs bsal zhu dgos tshang ma dang / bsnyen song nas dmigs bsal la/ khrus gtor chen/ seng sgra/ chab klu/ phyogs kyi bla mar 'gro dgos tshang ma 'gan len/ grwa tshang spyir/ sman bla/ dgu gtor/ cho 'phrul tha dkar smon lam/ sgrub mchod/ gtor bzlog gong 'phel rnams mdzad dgos pa dang / dmar chen gtor bzlog pu tra'i mdos gnyis skabs re dgos pa byung na kyai rdor dang drug cu pa thon pa rnams kyis byed/ dbyangs dpon bcu bzhi la dmigs bsal gnyer tshang gzhung gi srog gcod sdig bshags su dmigs/

bkra shis lha khang gi rnam rgyal dang / phag snying nyin gnyis/ bzhi pa'i dge tshe'i rab gnas rnams bya/ grwa tshang so sor bgo dgos la dgu pa'i chog mang skabs/ bde mchog gsang 'dus/ kyai rdor/ bdag med ma rnams la mgo nas bzung rim bzhin mchod dpon pas phyogs grwa ba mang nyung cha snyoms nas bgod/ mkha' spyod ma la cha snyoms kyi khongs de nas thon na dang / de min bsnyen song rgan pa kha shas nas byed/ rdo rje slob dpon ni nged rang nas chog mang su yong tshe bde mchog de phyin brgya dpon nas bzung rim bzhin bkod bzhag byed dgos pas/ sngar nas 'di skabs su rgyugs sprod byas chog 'dug kyang zhib tu dpyad na de skabs grwa tshang so sor cha snyoms dgos pas rgyugs sprod kyi phyogs grwa der bzhugs min sna tshogs shig 'dug pa nas/ phyin chad 'di skabs su rgyugs sprod lcags sbrul lor ban gtsang pa zhal grangs ma 'grigs pas bab rgyu lha chen nas 'then pa rnams kyai rdor gzhi bsnyen myur dgos stabs bdag med ma'i rgyugs sprod byed dgos byung song ba bzhin slan chad kyang dmigs bsal 'di rigs la bkag pa med cing gzhan bca' yig sor bzhag go mi byed/ dkar bskang gso'i skabs sgo rum nang so gnyis su ban gtsang bsnyen song byed dgos/ bsam gling du brgya dpon las chen ban gtsang dbu byed/ ban gtsang byings/ bsnyen song rnams re bzhin rdo rje slob dpon/ dbu byed/ mchod dpon rgan mgo'i gras su re mos byas ngos/ de'i khang skor bde gling grwa gsar rnams nas byed skabs/ slob dpon/ dbu byed/ mchod dpon gsum la 'ul rta re dang / gzhan thams cad la dos gang dgos/ yang ban gtsang pa dang lto zan lhan rgyas 'tshogs dgos drug pa'i tshes bzhi/ lha mo mchod/ byas 'gyur dang bla brang ma gtogs gtor spod kyi rigs/ zla re bzhin gyi sman bla bla mchod bsdus rgyu rnams/ mgon khang mtshan thogs skabs sku gnyer so so rang gnas/

de phyin mchod dpon pas cha snyoms su bgod/ bo dong er bskang gsol re 'byon tshe/ brgya las ban gtsang bsnyen song rnams re mos la rta dos gang dgos/ stod smad kyi bla ma zur sdod rnams dang / de 'phros mo 'grigs tshe byang sa ngag rgyun la bya chu rgan rgog tu grags pa rnams nas sgo rum du rgyun bskang bzhi grwa re/ sgrub mchod dang chabs cig bskang rgyun yod rigs rnams la khyad 'phags lho byang nang so rnams su mi grangs ci thob mchod dpon pas bgo lugs byed/ phur sgrub dang dus mdos skabs lha khang rtser yang bskang rgyun pa phral lugs byed/ dus mdos skabs der ma 'thus pa'i bde gling byings bskang rgyun pa'i gras su bgo lugs gong bzhin byed/ bla rigs rnams dus mdos skabs kyi bskang gso brgya tshar/ mgon po mnga' gsol/ gtor spod chen mo/ mthong ba don yod gtor spod/ hor zla lnga pa'i 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyi dgongs rdzogs mchod 'bul rnams rgyugs/ chos grwa lho byang lhan du 'tshog dgos/ 'bum ther sogs mang ja dmigs bsal rnams la bsnyen song dbu byed rig chung grwa la lho byang gang rung gi mgo dang / rgyun gyi mang jar byings btsun chung khrod gang 'os dang ban gtsang pa mang jar 'byon dgos tshul dam pa de nyid kyis lho byang gnyis su gnang ba'i bka' shog na 'dug kyang / dus rgyun chad med par sgor du bsgrigs na shin tu mang bas slan chad nged rang mang jar byung na ma gtogs 'byon mi dgos shing / ban gtsang pa 'di sngags 'chang chen po'i sku mdun bcar bzhugs dang / gzhan yang bla ma gong ma'i bka' srol thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyun 'dzin dgos stabs zhal ngo bgres pa yod na ma gtogs gdung brgyud rnams kyi sku yon gsan khungs yin pa bcas/ sngags 'chang chen po dang / 'jam mgon a mes zhabs sogs bla ma gong ma rnams kyis mthong bzos bdag rkyen 'bur dod gnang 'dug pa bzhin 'bum ther sogs kyi tshogs skal chad med dang /

gnas skabs kun tu dbu mdzad sogs las tshan rnams la gdan sogs kyi thob thang sngar srol bzang po bzhin dang / thams cad kyis gong du 'khur ba'i bkur bzos byed dgos min shes ldan gzur gnas kyis brtags pas gsal zhing / mchod yul ban gtsang pa rnams kyis kyang zhal 'don gsung dbyangs dal zhing 'grigs la cho ga phyag len phra mo tshun chad phul phyin gyi gtso bo mdzad nas bstan pa'i mig rgyan la phan pa zhig dang / grwa bco lnga po nang shin tu mthun nges mig ltos ngan pa gzhan gyis nam yang mi bslad pa zhig gal che/ tshogs chen cho ga'i skabs rdor dril dbu rgyan dar dpyangs tshang ma nged rang chog dpon du yod na/ ban gtsang pa dang lhan dbu mdzad la/ mchod khang nas dbu rgyan dar dpyangs rtsa chings rten khebs bcas/ mus chen mchod 'bul skabs khyams stod gung gral la ban gtsang pa dang de 'phros bsnyen song rnams bzhugs/ mchod khang nas rten khebs gsar rnying gang khyon gyi gsar bkye/ kun rig sgrub mchod skabs gung gral ban gtsang pa'i 'phros lha chen rab 'byams pa rnams dang / rgyab gral g.yas kyi mgor spyi pa/ g.yon gyi mgor lha chen dbu chos/ mtha' gral gyi mgor gzim chung bskor dpon/ de 'og byang gi chos khrims pa/ nged rang tshogs dpon la yod skabs gong ma gral gyi mgor mkhan chen/ brgya las de phyin gyi gral la rab 'byams pa rnams kyi 'og bsnyen song dang bka' bcu pa bsgrigs khyon dang bsnyen pa thon snga phyi'i gral rim byed/ dbu rgyan/ dar dpyangs/ rtsa chings rten khebs bcas tshogs pa gang yod la mchod khang nas 'don/ spyi chen dang tshogs chen dbu byed la sil snyan re/ rgyun gyi sgrub mchod tshang ma la/ dbu byed gsum la rol mo/ dus chos brgya las/ bde gling dbu byed/ ban gtsang sar sil snyan/ phur sgrub skabs rol sil gang mang gnyis nas bcu bzhi'i bar/ de nas bcu dgu'i bar dang / de nas nyer lnga'i bar dang /

de nas tshes gcig bar rab 'bring tha gsum cha spel ba'i re mos byed/ 'chams la/ dbu byed che pa dang de 'og mas rol sil/ dbu gzhon gyis bskul/ gtor bzlog rnams kyi skabs dmigs bsal dgos na ma gtogs rol sil 'bring grwa dang / dus mdos skabs dang dgongs rdzogs chen mo rab ston rnams kyi skabs rol mo gzab sprod/ de phyin sgrub mchod dbyings dang rgyun rnga mchod khang nas 'don/ phur sgrub dus mdos gnyis la gser rnga dang / gtor bzlog rnams la nag rnga gzhung nas 'don/ dgongs rdzogs chen mo dus mdos/ rab gnas rnams kyi gtor 'bul gyi skabs dang / zhabs bskor phal cher la chos dung gnyis/ rab gnas la slob dpon rdza dung / ban gtsang pa'i dung g.yog bsnyen song gi dung bcas 'don zhing dung mkhan ni bskul chung ba'i 'og nas gcig bskul chung bar ma bslebs bar dung dpon dang / de phyin re mos byed rgyu la/ phur sgrub dang bcu gcig pa'i dgongs rdzogs gnyis la sgrub mchod skabs re mos rdzogs par byed/ gzhan zla re la dung g.yog re mos/ phur sgrub skabs bsnyen song rnams nas dung chen dang dkar dung re mos/ gzhan rgyun gyi sgrub mchod tshang mar bsnyen song gral mgo ma gnyis kyi dung chen dang / de 'og ma gnyis kyi dkar dung / bde gling gi sbrel dung 'bud mi rgyal sgo'i nang bzhugs gzhi grwa rgan pa gnyis nas byed/ zhabs skor sogs la bde gling sku gnyer mkhar rnga dang / chos khrims pas spa rgyug dgongs rdzogs zhal zas bzo bskyed rnams chos khrims pas bsnyen song gang dgos la do dam/ ban gtsang pa'i dus gtor chen mo la dbu mdzad gsum nas zla rer rol mo re mos byings nas sil snyan re mos/ tshang mas zor las grub rim gyi gur drag dang dus gtor gyi bsgral mchod re mos/ mus chen chos 'bul dang drug pa tshes bzhi ban gtsang dbu mdzad gsum nas lo re mos kyi bskul/

de phyin che sa nas bskul chung pa gzhon pa'i bar bskul res byed/ bde gling 'du khang du 'tshog 'os tshang ma dang sman bla'i rigs byings dpon gyis rnam rgyal dang bzhi pa'i dge tshe'i rab gnas rnams bsnyen song dbu mdzad nas bskul/ zla ba drug pa'i g.ya' lung lo rim la bde gling dbu byed/ byang spyi pa gnyis/ de phyin bde gling lag bde ba gang dgos bcas grwa bcu gcig 'gro/ gtor chen kha 'bar ma sgrub mi bsnyen song dbu mdzad nas bzung bsnyen song re mos dang / gtor g.yog grwa gsar rnams re mos/ dus mdos kyi mol la ba bsnyen song dbu byed nas byed/ gdung rgyud khri phebs/ thang ston/ dga' ston sogs kyi mol la ba brgya tsho dpon nas byed/ dus mdos skabs ban gtsang pa dang bsnyen song skad bzang ba rnams gung gral lho byang rgyab gral lho byang gi dbyangs dpon bcu gsum dang drug cu pa'i dbyangs dpon bcas bcu bzhi bkod nas bstod dbyangs re mos byed dgos rnams so sos thog ma nas skad sgra tshig lhad dbyangs kyi lhu sogs gra sgrig gis dbyangs sbyangs nan chen byas ngos/ dngos gzhi'i skabs dbyangs dal zhing 'grig la snyan 'gyur dod pa zhig byed dgos rgyur slan chad su thad nas ma 'grig kyang las tshan rnams la skyon sel gyi kha ta dang 'chugs tshabs shin tu che na mar chad nyag bzhi 'gel/ gtso dbyangs pa rdo rje slob dpon dang dbu mdzad rnams nas byas steng nyer dgu'i skabs g.yas g.yon gung gsum nas bskul tshul phyag deb bzhin/ las mgon lnga 'cham mi bsnyen song 'chams gzugs dod pa lngas 'chams khral 'jal tsam ma yin pa'i theg pa khur blang byed/ zor las pa chos las pa gnyis dang gro nag spu gsum gyi bla ma ngo mas byed/ gtor bzlog dang gtor 'bul sogs kyi skabs spung nas 'byon pa zhig snga thog nas 'dug 'di ni rnga rol gral mi 'grig cing gnas khang dang phyag cha sogs la gzan che bas/

da nas bzung bzhi thog tu gtor 'bul byings la steng du 'byon skabs g.yon gral gyi mtha' nas bzung rnga pa rnams skas lho nas/ gral rim bzhin 'byon/ phye tsam rdzogs tshe rol mo ba rnams dung pa g.yas mtha' nas bzung skas byang brgyud dang / dus gtor las chen shar nub kyi gtor 'bul la rnga pa rnams skas byang dang rol mo ba rnams lho nas brgyud/ gtor bzlog byings la rnga pa g.yon gral gyi mtha' dang / rol mo ba g.yas gral gyi mtha' nas bskal gyi skabs gral ji ltar bsgrigs pa bzhin dang 'bag pa zor las pa rnams de thams cad kyi rjes su 'gro/ dus mdos kyi 'chams sku gdan 'dren skabs gzhi thog bcom rol rdzogs nas kyang gral sgrig la 'byon/ byon skyems rdzogs pa'i rol mo chig brdung du bsgyur rjes thog mar mdung pa bzhi gral bsgrigs/ skye bso dpon gral bsgrigs/ de nas dung chen gnyis nyis gshibs/ de rgyab sbu khag gnyis nyis gshibs/ de nas rim pa ltar phye phur ba gang yod nyes gshibs mdun rgyab gral rim/ de nas rkang gling pa gnyis nyis gshibs/ de nas chos dung dang mkhar rnga ba nyis gshibs/ de rjes brgya tsho dpon dbu chen pa/ de nas rnga dpon dang byings gras gsum/ yang rol sil gnyis/ de nas rim pa ltar rnga dpon rnams rgan gzhon gyi gral rim ltar bsgrigs dgos pas rnga rol pa gang yod thog ma nas brtsi/ rnga ci tsam gyi mtshams su rol sil gang thob lhur 'then par byas nas byon na legs pas/ thog mar rnga rol bsgrig skabs rnga rol gyi gtso bo rnams dbus nas zur thon du 'byon dgos pa sogs gral bkod tshang ma mchod dpon pas byed/ rnga rol rdzogs nas nag ring pa sogs 'bag pa rnams spungs/ spos phor ba gnyis nyis gshibs/ de rgyab rgya gling pa gnyis nyis gshibs/ de'i rgyab gser skyems pa gnyis nyis gshibs/ de nas 'chams sku rnams da lta bzhin/ sa skya tshogs su rnga rol tshang ma byang nas lhor gral ring gcig bsgrigs pa'i rgyab na sngon 'gros pa rnams gral bsgrig

de nas yang sngar bzhin byon la gzhi thog tu mdung pa nas chos dung gi bar da ltar bzhin dang / rnga rol bsgrigs tshul ni gong zhing gral der shugs las grub bo/ /nyer dgu tshogs chen por 'chams sku pha lam bzhengs tshar nas/ gnod sbyin yab yum nas bzung 'bag pa rnams 'chams sku la bskor ba'i tshul du 'cham sku'i g.yas dang rol mo rnams kyi rgyab nas 'ongs te khri chung gi mdun tsam 'gro/ bya khra dmar 'dir bzhugs gzhi bdag dang / sngar bcol legs pa'i dbyangs tshugs bstun/ rnga rol gyi hrag la mas nas zhugs/ rol mo dang bstun dbu chen pa ma yin pa'i rol mo ba gang 'os kyi mtshams nas rgyab tu mchongs/ bskul rdzogs nas dar pa dung pa/ g.yag zeng pa sngags bon rnams sngon la rdzong ba'i do dam spyi chen/ lde chung pa/ lha khang las thog pa lha bris dbu byed rnams la byed dgos tshul byang las tshan rnams nas thog ma nas zer/ rnga pa g.yon gral dang rol mo ba g.yas nas bzung 'chams sku la bskor ba'i tshul gyis g.yas bskor du phyin pa'i rjes su/ ser skya'i 'bag pa gang yod/ zor las pa ru 'dren dge slong dang bud med/ 'chams sku rnams 'byon/ de bzhin du bya khra ma nas bzung 'chams sku la bskor ba mi byed pa tsam ma gtogs gral rim gong bzhin/ dus mdos sogs gtor ma rnams thebs nas kyang slob dpon tshang ma gral rim gyis 'byon pa ma gtogs babs chol du mi 'byon/ phur sgrub chen mo'i sa skya tshogs kyi 'cham rnga rting skabs thog mar lag khyer ba rnams gral dang / de nas rnga rol pa rnams bzhugs skabs ji lta ba bzhin gyi gral la g.yas gral gyi mtha' ma nas rim bzhin 'byon pa'i rjes su 'chams pa gral rim bzhin dang / rgyab nas gos rtsi ma gyon pa'i mi skya rnams sbungs nas 'gro/ dus chen zhabs bskor rnams kyi skabs kyang mchod dpon pas gral bkod byas pa bzhin dang 'cham sku gdan 'dren dang phebs skyel/

dus mdos kyi tshogs chen mo nas 'byon skabs dang / dmar chen gyi gnod sbyin 'byang sogs kyi bskul rdzogs nas 'byon skabs dang gtor 'bul rnams la rnga nang rdung g.yon du bya nyal/ gtor bzlog rnams kyi skabs su rnga phyir rdung dung g.yas su bya nyal byas ngos/ mchod rol nyis rdung ma la rnga dal rdung mchod rol chig brdung drag rol gyi gras sum rdung sogs la rol mo dang bstun nas brdung ba sogs skabs su babs pa'i rnga rol shin tu 'grig pa kho na las/ snang bar gang yang ma shar bar bab chol gyi brdungs pa dang / blo skyon can gyis che gtad rdung ba sogs byung nas las tshan rnams nas skyon 'don bslab bya dang / 'gal tshabs can la brgya phyag sogs chad pa lci yang gang rung bab blta byed/ phyogs nas 'byor ba'i khams pa grwa rgyun rnams kyi lto rten re phul phyin grwa sar sdod ring gnyer khang nas phogs dang / sgrub mchod yod skabs des go bcad/ sdod yul bla gnyer tshogs dpon de rang sogs nas bsnyen song dbu byed dang / bde gling sgo srung par rgyu mtshan byas thog nang gang rigs su gtod pa dang phyi gtsug lag khang gi sku gnyer tshang mas kyang rten gtsug lag khang gi zhig gso thigs tshags gad dar rnams dang / brten pa sku brnyan so sor rdul sprug snyan shal na bza' sogs sgros legs shing mchod cha byings bkod pa mdzes pa dang / khyad par yon chab zhal zas mchod me rnams rang gzhan dwang ba 'dren zhing tshogs rdzogs pa'i phyir shin tu sgros gtsang ba/ khyad par mgon khang rnams su gtsang sbra gang che ngos/ rten mjal zhu mi dmigs bsal rnams ma gtogs dgos med du mi skya sogs tha mal pa rnams gtan nas mi gtong zhing rgyun bskang yod gras rnams ma chags par byed/ sde spyi nas sa rtsi sgron dgos pa rnams ma gtogs gzhan gtsug lag khang tshang ma'i sa rtsi rnams kyang rang rang nas spus gtsang dang ba gtong /
