gtsug lag khang rnams dang grwa khang lcags ri la nyams chag che nges byung na sku gnyer so so dang bsnyen song dbu byed/ bde gling sgo srung pa rnams nas gzhung du rgyu mtshan byas nges/ nyams gso byas phyin bcag dag yod pa zhig dang / de ltar ma yin par gtsug lag khang rnams nyams su bcug pa dang / rang rang gi brang khang spyi pa dang sgo srung pas blta dgos lcags ri sogs la bcag thon ma byas pa'i nyams chags byung na gdong gang ngo skal du gyur pa de la gzhung nas chad pa babs lci yang nyes byas dang bstan gang rung re 'gel nges yin pas de bzhin mi 'byung ba zhig so so nas blos blangs 'gyur med dang / de bzhin du rnga rol dung 'chams chas sogs gnas skabs su gang dgos tshang mar bcag dag kho nas bstan don lar rgyar phan pa zhig ma byung na/ phan tshun gnyis ka dus rgyun du so so'i mtshang 'bru ba dang / rtsod pa kho na byas tshe shugs kyis nyams grib sogs gegs chag kun 'byung nges pas slan chad bdag don bdag gces tshang mar mdzad pa gal che zhing gal te de dag la sems skyon chags pa'i chu zos shin tu che ba byung na nyes can rang gi lag nas dngos po de ngo ma len pa'am de dod 'pher ba zhig len rgyu dang / phran bu la ni phyi lam kheg pa'i kha ta zhi drag gang rung byed/ sbu gu can dang gong can sogs 'dul ba'i kun spyod dang 'gal ba rnams bshags bya'i nyes byas tsam du gsungs pas gong ba can bla ma gong ma ye shes spyan ldan rnams kyis kyang phod ka'i nang dang / dung mkhan mtshan mo'i gtor bzlog gi rigs phyogs 'gro rnams la gnang ba dmigs bsal tsam ma gtogs dus rgyun du bag med du mi gyon/ chu tshan sogs kyi skabs sbu gu can gnang ba ma gtogs gzhan gnas skabs kun tu mi gyon/ zhwa rigs kyang tshogs 'du rnams la rtse zhwa dmar po zhwa mtshungs dang / phyogs 'grul khag chen dang lha mo mchod la rtse dmar sgro theb ma rtse g.yas bstan gzhan skya theb dang bir zhwa gnyis 'os 'tshams las mi nag dkyus 'dra'i zhwa rigs rnams mi gyon/

chos 'chad nyan gyi rtsa ba zhal ngo nas rkang len mdzad kyang / bla ma gong ma'i man ngag zab mo rnams la byang chub pa dang / rgyun mi nyams shing mang du spel ba'i phyir las tshan sogs grwa bgres rnams nas dbang lung man ngag khrid sogs rdo rje theg pa'i chos bka' zab mo rnams 'chad gang thub ngos/ snyan brgyud thun mong ma yin pa'i rigs rnams dbye ba shes pas bab chol du ma song bzhin dgos rgyu dang / sngar nas bzung stod smad kyi bla ma rnams kyi g.yog grwa rigs chos grwa 'di dang / lha chen grwa shar gyi grwa pa sogs nas gtong srol 'dug pa rnams slar byang gi sgrig rgyugs gras la bzhugs tshe de snga phan gling med du bsdad chog kyang / da phyin chad phyogs 'grul ba rnams grwa tshang du 'jug tshe sngar thob pa'i bslab pa 'bul chog ngos/ bslab gtsang bskyar nas len dgos pa ni de skabs 'dul ba'i spyod pa dang 'gal ba'i 'jig rten bya brel sna tshogs dang 'brel che ba'i nyes pa sel phyir yin pas de bzhin dang / gong bkod ltar rtsa ba bzhi la yan lag cha tshang ba'i nyes tshabs mi nag dkyus 'gre lta bu rnams bstan pa'i rgyun la phan pa'i phyir grwa tshang du gtan nas mi 'jug bsnyen sgrib zla grangs can dang / dpe mtshams pa/ bsgrigs rgyugs mu nas phung pos ma lcogs par skabs re sdod dgos pa rnams nas lho byang thun mong du byung ba'i mang ja dkor skal len/ zhal 'don gyis mtshon cho ga phyag len tshang ma shin tu nges shing khungs btsun pa ni snga thog nas bzung da bar brgya dpon/ ban gtsang pa'i dbu byed gsum la rim can du byung 'dug pas dge rgan kyang de rnams la 'chol ba dang / rgyal sgo'i khongs kyi brang khang rnams stong par mi bzhag par khrigs khengs pa zhig byung na snyam pas/ sku gnyer dang dge rgan gyi thab tshang mchod khang rnams ma gtogs gzhan tshang ma lcags ri'i khongs su bzhugs rgyur/ 'dug mi nyan pa rnams dang lcags ri sogs nyams bzo tshang ma sngar gyi mig ltos lta bu ma yin par zhe thag gi kha lta nged rang nas mdzod pa sogs su bkod khyab byed rtsis yin pas/

de nas bzung rgyal sgo'i nang gi brang khang rnams su thog mar bzhugs skabs dang / slar pho mtshams gnyis ka la bsnyen sogs dbu byed/ khang dpon/ sgo srung gsum dpang gi lta rtogs dang / gang ci'i mtshams khyab 'doms che ba gal che/ mdor na bca' yig 'di don phyin tshang mar bla ma gong ma'i bstan lar rgya dang / rang gzhan tshang ma'i 'di phyi'i don la bsam blo btang ngos che 'bring chung du mtha' dag la spang blang go 'dzol med pa zhig da nas bzung ji srid chos grwa 'di gnas kyi bar 'dus tshogs rim can rnams nas lhag bsam che bskyed dang / de dag gi do dam legs slob nyes 'chos tshang ma 'pho 'chugs med pa bstar chags kyi 'gan blang brgya tsho dpon/ ban gtsang dbu byed gsum/ mchod dpon pa/ bsnyen song dbu byed rnams nam lcogs bar dang / chos khrims pa re mos lo re bcas bstar chags nas ngo dga' drag zhan/ rang ltos/ dgra 'dul/ gnyen skyong / dkar skyong / nag 'ded sogs lugs gnyis khrims 'gal du ma song ba'i drang bzhag chos khrims gtsang ma mthar phyin du skyong ba dang / de la 'dus tshogs spyi bo nas dad gus kyis dwang len mdzad pa gal che/ gal te las tshan rnams nas bstan don ma bsam pa'i khrims kyog sna tshogs byung ba dang / las tshan gyis lugs mthun byas kyang grwa tshang byings nas bab 'chol nyes med nyes 'gel gyi rigs shar tshe las tshan gyis ma byung ba'i thad grwa tshang byings dang / grwa tshang byings nas ma byung ba'i thad las tshan rnams nas 'di gar 'phros bgyis ngos/ bden rdzun dbye 'byed kyi khrims gzhung drang po zhig nged rang nas byed rgyu'i dpang por/ dpal sa skya'i rje btsun gong ma ye shes spyan ldan rnams dang / gur zhal sogs rdo rje'i chos skyong srung ma rnams bzhugs pas thams cad kyi de ltar go dgos shing snyigs ma'i dus 'dir dge 'dun rnams kyi bsgrigs lugs mthun 'di gzhan las phan yon che zhing gcur dag sgrig khyon yang shin tu dka' ba zhig yong 'dug pa nas/

chos khrims kho chu yos nas bzung bca' yig rin po che 'di'i zhabs 'degs su dmigs sa skya pa dbang gi ming can gyis ban gtsang chos khrims chen mor grags pa 'di bsko bzhag bgyis pa yin/ nas mi 'jug na/ 'jam dbyangs sa paṇa gyis/ 'jig rten lugs kyi rjes 'brang nas/ /bdag gis dam pa'i chos 'di bstan/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rgyal khrims gzhung bsrang gi brjed nan ngos/ chos khrims yang dag pa'i dge legs chu bo'i rgyun lta bu zhig bstan pa dang sems can gyi don du byung na snyam pa'i lhag bsam rnam par dag pa kho nas dbang byas pa yin pas grwa tshang tshang mas dgongs par zhu/ jag khyer spyod cing byung na 'di phyi gnyis med yong bas/ rang sems la rang gis bya ra gtang / grwa thabs 'grig pa rang gal che/ de yang gangs can gyis bde skyid dang / dge legs thams cad kyi 'byung gnas dpal sa skya'i dgon gnas bstan dang bstan 'dzin bcas yin tshul mkhas grub du mas dang gzur gnas kyi skye bo kun gyis rlung ltar sgrog pa 'di yin don bzhin las/ rang cag rjes 'jug rnams nas rje btsun gong ma spyi dang / khyad par sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i rnam thar la bsam blo btang nas/ de'i dgongs pa dang mi 'gal ba zhig ni shin tu gal che bas de bzhin du dge 'dun thams cad kyis mdzad 'tshal/ ༈ dpal ldan sa skya'i bstan pa rin chen rgyun/ /rgyun bzang chad la thug pa snyigs ma'i dus/ /dus ngan 'di 'drar ma nor thar pa'i lam/ /lam bzang gsal bar ston pa'i bka' drin can/ /gos dkar ngur smrig 'dzin mdzad bla ma rje/ /kho bo'i yongs 'dzin rnams las lhag pa zhig /dus gsum phyogs bcur lan grangs du ma'i bar/ /zhib mo'i blo yis btsal yang rnyed re skan/ /de bas byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi/ /gsang sngags rgyud sde'i don la rab mkhas shing / /gsang sngags rnal 'byor zab mo'i ting 'dzin can/ /gsang sngags 'dzin pa rgya mtsho'i bsti gnas la/

/gsang sngags bde chen gling zhes 'di na 'bod/ /kyi hud deng sang dus kyi sngags 'chang 'ga'/ /la las dbang ma thob par grol byed sgom/ /'ga' zhig dbang bskur thob kyang sdom pa yi/ /dbye ba thob mtshams rtsa ltung sbyang gzhi dang / /sbyong byed don rnams cung zad mi shes na'ang / /chog khrigs tsam re smra rgyu yod pa la/ /nged cag rdo rje 'dzin pa yin no zhes/ /kun la sgrog cing tshe gang dkor rdzas la/ /gzhan pa'i bza' btung sdig med dang bral ba'i/ /gang zag 'di ni chos mdzad dor bya'i yul/ /mnyam gzhag bsam gtan spyod lam mi ldan par/ /myos pa'i lus bzhin 'gyel lam rkang lag brkyangs/ /yang na kha chu nar zhing gnyid dbang song / /skyon tshang 'di yis lus la 'bral med byas/ /bzlas brjod zab mo nyams su len pa'i tshe/ /tshig don ma 'brel bab chol sna tshogs kyis/ /smyon pa bzhin du gang thon smra ba sogs/ /smyon tshogs 'di yis ngag la 'bras med byas/ /gzung 'os bsgom bya'i dmigs pa ring spangs nas/ /sems kyi spre'u khams gsum thams cad myur/ /legs tshogs spangs nas nyes tshogs kun sdud pa'i/ /skyon tshang 'di yis yid la 'bras med byas/ /'das la 'gyod bzhin ma 'ongs re dogs dang / /da lta'i chags sdang rtsi ba'i dus yol nas/ /thun re'ang byas la ma bsags sgrub byed pa'i/ /skyon tshang 'di yi thar pa'i re thag bcad/ /rjes thob sgo gsum bya ba ji snyed pa/ /phal cher mi dge lung ma bstan du spyod/ /cung zad dge yang bzang rtog dug dang 'dres/ /skyon tshang 'di yis ngan 'gro'i rgyu tshogs spel/ /dus skabs phal cher za nyal 'chag gsum gyi/ /bag med spyod pas 'jig rten pa ltar lugs/ /skabs 'gar snod bcud lha dang gzhal yas su/ /'bad pas bsgom kyang dag snang de'i ngang la/ /rang sems skad cig tsam yang gnas ma thub/ /de bzhin chos kun gshis lugs brjod bral la/ /dran 'dun drag pos yang yang sems bzhag kyang /

/bde stong ngang du seng nge yer re ba/ /cung zad tsam yang gnas pa'i mthu ma rnyed/ /de phyir sems dang ma 'brel nyams len 'dis/ /chos par grags pa'i ming stong sgra che yang / /gnyis phung las la sbyar dogs sems re 'tshab/ /'ga' zhig gshin la snying rje'i sems med cing / /gsol la phan pa'i bsam pa ring spangs nas/ /gser g.yu ja dar bsgom pa'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /cho ga'i tshig don kun kyang 'chol por 'thor/ /phongs pa'i tshogs kyis zas 'tshol ji bzhin du/ /blun po dga' ba'i rnga rdung bro 'khrab dang / /ci dran dbyangs su len pa'i rdzun chog gis/ /rang gzhan gnyis ka phung la sbyor ba mthong / /gzhung don ji bzhin sgom pa lta zhog gi /tshig rjes sems kyis 'brang bar mi nus pa/ /ne tso'i 'don pa lta bu'i rdzun chog gi /don gnyis mthar phyin 'grub re kye ma hud/ /kha cig bsnyen pa ma song man ngag bral/ /bsnyen bkur 'dod phyir las bzhi'i 'gro don gzugs/ /tshe 'dir nad mang phyi ma ngan 'gro'i rgyu/ /de 'dra'i sngags 'chang gzugs brnyan mthong bas skyo/ /'ga' zhig dag gis mi shes bzhin du sngags par khas blangs nas/ /rgyud dang bla ma'i gsung la mi brten cho ga rang bzor byed/ /rgyu mtshan dris na phyag len yin zhes gong ma ra mdar sbran/ /slar yang dris lan khro byed dus 'dir gcig pur nags khrod bsten/ /deng sang 'di na long bas long ba 'khrid cing mkhas pa rnams sar smod/ /rnyed dang bkur sti blun po la gnas mkhas pa dag gi 'dun par dben/ /chos byed skye bo bzhi mdo'i rtswa ltar bor nas ngan pa'i skye bo bsten/ /dus kyi thub bstan 'di ltar gyur to kun gyis bag yod bsten par gyis/ /des na gzhon nu rab byung tshul khrims ldan/ /dbang lung man ngag rgyud don khong du chud/ /rang gzhan don gnyis sgrub pa'i lhag bsam can/ /de 'dra gang bzhugs rdo rje 'dzin zhes grags/ /sngon 'khor bar lan mang 'khyams pa'i tshe/

/las bzang po smon lam gyis sbrel ba'i/ /dpal sa skya'i sngags grwa'i 'dus tshogs nas/ /las dge ba gsog tshul cung zad bshad/ /dus lo gcig zla ba gcu gnyis kyi/ /rje bla ma rnams kyi dus chen skabs/ /lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi/ /chos nyams len bla ma mchod chog dang / /tshul de dang 'brel ba'i smon lam bzhin/ /rje gong ma rnams kyi bstod rigs sogs/ /lan lnga phrag lhag re chag med dang / /de'i steng du tshogs chen bla mchod sogs/ /kun dril ba'i 'gyur khyad rtsis pa na/ /rje gong bstod bla mchod smon lam sogs/ /dus lo rer stong rwa lhag tsam re/ /rje sngags 'chang yab sras mus chen sogs/ /mgon dam pa rnams kyi bstod thung rnams/ /lo gcig la khri 'di yan ban gtsang pa bco lnga'i grangs gsog byas pa la dgongs gnyis stong gnyis lhag /chos zab mo nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i/ /lam tshes bcu bsgrub mchod chags med dang / gzhan mkha' spyod sgrub mchod rnams bsdoms pas/ /lo gcig gi nang la oṃ gsum ma/ /'bum gnyis dang khri stong bzhi lhag /dpe 'dis mtshon bde kyai gsang gsum dang / /dpal rdo rje phur pa kun rig sogs/ /sngags zab mo'i dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod dang / /lha bsgom bzlas sogs kyi grangs tshad kyang / /'gyur brtsis pas mang du 'gro bar nges/ /dpal kyai rdor rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis kyang / /lo gcig la khri dang brgyad brgya re/ /dus cho 'phrul tha skar zla phyed la/ chos sman bla smon lam dpag med 'gro/ /ma mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs/ /thugs mnyes par byed pa'i bskang gso yang / /lo re rer khri tshar stong tshar dang / /gzhan brgya tshar mang du 'gro nges lags/ /tshul de ltar bsags pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /spyi bye brag bstan pa rab rgyas shing / /rgyun rigs rgyud gtsang mas skyong ba dang / /bdag dpon slob 'di phyi'i don 'grub shog /tshig de skad rnam dkar dge las la/

/yid spro ba mchog tu skyed pa'i gtam/ /blo shes ldan dga' bde'i dpal ster 'di/ /mgon a mes zhabs kyi mgur ma lags/ /rab brjid 'jig dus du ba stong gis 'khyud pa'i sku ni 'bar ba'i rta gdong me dang 'grogs/ /hūm̐ zhes 'jigs rung gnam lcags sgra las ljags kyi phreng ba dmar 'od glog gi thag pa g.yo/ /drag por khros pa'i mthar byed zhal gyi mche ba'i myu gu zla ba phyed pa stong phrag brtsegs/ /nyi zla'i mdangs 'phrog spyan gsum 'bar bas bgegs rnams mthar mdzad sa skya'i bstan srung mthu ldan tshogs/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bka' dang dam tshig dran par gyis la gsang sngags zab mo'i chos grwa 'dir/ /dam chos sgrub la phyi nang gsang ba'i nyer 'tshe rnams dang bdag gis brtsams pa'i bca' yig las/ /'gal byed kun sgrol rje btsun gong ma'i ring lugs 'dzin pa ji snyed kyis/ /srid zhi'i dpal 'byor bsam pa'i don kun chos bzhin 'grub pa'i phrin las g.yel ba med par mdzod/ /ces chos grwa chen po gsang sngags bde chen gleng gi bca' yig lhag bsam nyi 'od gsal ba'i 'od snang zhes bya ba 'di yang sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos rje btsun gong ma'i sngags grwa khyad par can 'di la zhabs tog rngo thogs pa zhig byung na ci ma rung snyam pa'i lhag bsam rnam par dag pas kun nas bslangs te gong bkod kyi gsung rab khyad par can rnams la gzhi byas sgrig lam kun spyod mthong brgyud rnams rtsa bar bzung de dag la legs slob nyes 'chos rang shes tshang ma sba gsang med par bkod pa 'di la gzhan dag dgyes kyang rung ma dgyes kyang rung nged rang gi mgon skyabs dpung gnyen tshang ma sa skya'i rje btsun gong ma bstan srung dang bcas pa rnams dang / shes ldan gzur gnas tshad thub kyi skyes bu rnams dang / sa skya'i rje btsun gong ma'i bstan pa la/

snying nas dad pa yod pa rnams gyis mdzad nas chos grwa chen po 'di nyid dar zhing rgyas pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ //'di ni snag shog gzan pa dang rtsis 'khri byin rten tsam du ma lus par rjes gnon khra bzung do dam rim can las tshan rnams nas ma chad pa gal che bas de bzhin tshang mas go dgos so// //sarba maṅga laṃ// //zhus so// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ chos grwa chen po gsang sngags bde chen gling gi bca' yig PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
